Vaziyat: Boxes for the Fair ↔ The Toy Table
explain: Har bir doska modelini vaziyat yoki buyum bilan oching. Avval o‘zingiz namuna qiling, keyin juftlikda, oxirida yordamsiz tekshiring. Ot va artiklni o‘tilgan be bilan ishlating; yangi harakat zamoni shart emas. 3.1: Oddiy ko‘plik -s olib tashlanadi: books → book. 3.2: Oxiri -x bilan tugagan otga -es qo‘shiladi. 3.3: Undosh + y bilan tugasa y o‘rniga -ies: cities. O‘qish — «Boxes for the Fair»: avval mazmunni ayttiring, so‘ng har javob yonida matndagi dalilni belgilang. Tinglash — «The Toy Table»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. Undosh + y da ies, unli + y da s. Leaf → leaves ni berilgan namuna sifatida oling; barcha f bilan tugagan otlar bir xil emas. Reading: avval sarlavha va rasm/real buyum, keyin uch savolga matndan dalil. Listening: matnni yashirib ikki marta tabiiy, sekin o‘qing; avval kim/nima, keyin tafsilot. Savolni o‘zbekcha tushuntiring, bir so‘zli javobni qabul qiling. Qiynaluvchiga ikki tanlov va ko‘rsatish imkonini bering; tez ishlovchiga shu shaklda boshqa rasm bering. Gapirish vazifasi: Yarmarka kartalarida bir va ko‘p buyumni juft ayting. Boxes, toys, cities, leaves ni ishlating; harakatni tasvirlash shart emas. Yozish vazifasi: To‘rtta birlik → ko‘plik yorlig‘i va ikki rang gapi yozing. Tayyor yozuv namunasini dastlabki urinishdan keyin ko‘rsating; nusxa ko‘chirishni mustaqil natija deb baholamang.

16.5 · Don’t / doesn’t have to — zarur emas: You don’t have to bring food.
16.6 · Have to — questions: Do we have to book? Does she have to pay?
16.7 · Had to — o‘tgan majburiyat: I had to work yesterday.
16.8 · Didn’t have to / did…have to?: I didn’t have to wait. Did you have to pay?
16.9 · Will have to — kelajakdagi zarurat: We will have to leave early.
16.10 · Mustn’t vs don’t have to: Don’t enter. / Entering is optional.
16.11 · Should — positive: maslahat: You should get some rest.
16.12 · Shouldn’t — negative: You shouldn’t skip meals.
16.13 · Should — questions: What should I do? Should I call her?
16.14 · Ought to / had better: You ought to rest. We’d better leave.
16.15 · Need to / don’t need to / needn’t: You needn’t hurry.
16.16 · Needn’t have vs didn’t need to: I needn’t have bought bread; we already had some.

17.4 · Can’t — hozirgi imkonsiz taxmin: He can’t be at school; it’s closed.
17.5 · Could…? — ehtimol haqida savol: Could this be the right address?
17.6 · Modal + be + -ing: She might be working now.
17.7 · Must have + V3 — o‘tgan kuchli taxmin: They must have missed the bus.
17.8 · May / might / could have + V3: She might have forgotten the date.
17.9 · Can’t / couldn’t have + V3: He can’t have finished already.

17.11 · Shouldn’t have + V3 — afsus: I shouldn’t have said that.
17.12 · Could have + V3 — foydalanilmagan imkon: We could have taken a taxi, but we walked.

checkQuestions: Hozirgi ehtimol uchun may/might/could dan mosini yozing: I am not sure, but the keys ___ be in the garage. [Javob: may / might / could. Uchala modal ham bu gapda hozirgi ehtimolni bildiradi.]
May bilan ehtimoliy inkorni yozing: Perhaps Sara does not recognise us. Sara ___ recognise us. [Javob: may not. May not ehtimol tanimasligini bildiradi, qat’iy taqiqni emas.]
Must orqali hozirgi kuchli taxminni yozing: Ali has worked three night shifts. He ___ (be) exhausted. [Javob: must be. Hozirgi holatga dalil asosidagi kuchli taxmin must + be orqali ifodalanadi.]
Can't bilan kuchli inkoriy taxmin: That ___ be our bus; its number is wrong. [Javob: cannot / can't. Can't be dalil asosida bu holat mumkin emasligini bildiradi.]

Hozirgi ehtimol haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Could that noise be the washing machine? B) Could be that noise the washing machine? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi could + ega + be; be egadan keyin keladi.]
Qavsdagi fe’lni davom etayotgan ehtimolga qo‘ying: Dad might ___ (sleep) upstairs now. [Javob: be sleeping. Modal + be + -ing ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.]
Must have bilan to‘ldiring: The grass is wet, though nobody watered it. It ___ (rain) overnight. [Javob: must have rained. O‘tgan voqeaga kuchli taxmin: must have + V3.]
Might have bilan to‘ldiring: Perhaps I sent the letter to the old address. I ___ (send) it there. [Javob: might have sent. Might have + V3 o‘tgan ehtimolni bildiradi.]

Can't have bilan to‘ldiring: The parcel arrived ten minutes ago. You ___ (collect) it yesterday. [Javob: cannot have collected / can't have collected. Can't have + V3 o‘tgan harakatning imkonsizligi haqidagi xulosadir.]
Should have bilan afsusni to‘ldiring: I got lost. I ___ (save) the map before leaving. [Javob: should have saved. Should have saved qilish yaxshi bo‘lgan, ammo qilinmagan ishni bildiradi.]

Shouldn't have bilan to‘ldiring: I told everyone her secret. I ___ (say) anything. [Javob: should not have said / shouldn't have said. Shouldn't have said bajarilgan, ammo noto‘g‘ri bo‘lgan ishga afsusdir.]
Could have bilan to‘ldiring: A neighbour offered a lift, but we walked. We ___ (accept) it. [Javob: could have accepted. Could have accepted mavjud, ammo ishlatilmagan imkoniyatni bildiradi.]

Present Continuous ni Past Continuous ga o‘tkazing; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Omar said, ‘I am measuring the wall.’ → Omar said that he ___ the wall. [Javob: was measuring. Davomiy zamonning backshift shakli was/were + -ing: am measuring → was measuring.]

Past Simple ni Past Perfect ga suring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Ben said, ‘I broke the handle.’ → Ben said that he ___ the handle. [Javob: had broken. Broke ning Past Perfect shakli had broken: had + break fe’lining uchinchi shakli.]

Xabar hozir aytilmoqda. Zamonni ortga surmang; faqat fe’lni yozing: Farida says, ‘I teach biology.’ → Farida says that she ___ biology. [Javob: teaches. Says hozirgi zamonda bo‘lgani uchun backshift kerak emas. She egasi bilan teach ga -es qo‘shiladi.]

Faqat egalik olmoshini yozing: Mark said, ‘My passport has expired.’ → Mark said that ___ passport had expired. [Javob: his. My so‘zi dastlab Markka tegishli. Mark haqida boshqa kishi xabar berganda his bo‘ladi.]

Dushanba kuni Leo ‘I will return tomorrow,’ dedi. Buni payshanba kuni yetkazyapsiz. Tomorrow o‘rniga the bilan boshlanuvchi iborani yozing: Leo said he would return ___. board: 25.1 · And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash: I called, but nobody answered.
25.2 · Because / since / as — sabab: We stayed in because it was raining.
25.3 · Because of / due to + noun phrase: The match stopped because of the rain.
25.4 · So / therefore / as a result — natija: It was late, so we left.
25.5 · Although / even though + clause: Although it was cold, we went out.
25.6 · Despite / in spite of + noun / -ing: Despite the rain, we went out.
25.7 · However / nevertheless — qarshi fikr: It was cold. However, we went out.
25.8 · While / whereas — taqqoslab qarshi qo‘yish: I prefer tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
25.9 · So…that — sifat/ravish bilan natija: It was so cold that we stayed inside.
25.10 · Such…that — ot birikmasi bilan natija: It was such a good book that I read it twice.
25.11 · To / in order to / so as to — maqsad: I study to improve my English.
25.12 · So that + clause — maqsad: I spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.
25.13 · Before / after / until / as soon as: Wait until I return.
25.14 · In case vs if — ehtiyot va shart: Take a coat in case it gets cold.
25.15 · Both…and / either…or / neither…nor: You can either walk or take a bus.
25.16 · Not only…but also — parallel shakllar: She is not only kind but also patient.
25.17 · Adding and exemplifying — qo‘shimcha/misol: Moreover…; for example…; for instance…
25.18 · Paragraph links and punctuation: It was raining; however, we continued.

Bir xil xato qilgan juftlarni birlashtiring, so‘ng yangi parallel misol bilan qayta tekshiring. 25.1: Or muqobil tanlovlarni bildiradi: karta bilan yoki naqd to‘lash mumkin. 25.2: Fog covered the runway ega va fe’lli gap bo‘lgani uchun because kerak; because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi. 25.3: A power failure ot birikmasi, shu sababli uning oldidan because of ishlatiladi. 25.4: Birinchi qism sabab, ikkinchisi natija. So avtomobilning yurmaganini natija sifatida bog‘laydi. 25.5: The route was steep ega-fe’lli gap. Although undan oldin kelib, kutilmagan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi. 25.6: Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: despite having a headache. 25.7: Qimmatlikka qaramay hamma joy sotilgan. Such + a/an + sifat + ot + that qolipi ishlatiladi. 25.11: Inkor maqsad in order not to + fe’l bilan beriladi: bemorlarni uyg‘otmaslik uchun. 25.12: Keyingi qismning o‘z egasi va modal fe’li bor: the engineer could. Bunday maqsad gapini so that bog‘laydi. 25.13: Kelajak ma’nosidagi as soon as vaqt ergash gapida odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi, will qo‘yilmaydi. 25.14: In case ehtimoliy muammo yuz berishidan oldin tayyorlanishni bildiradi: internet uzilib qolishi ehtimoliga qarshi nusxa saqlanadi. 25.15: Neither ... nor juftligi ikki narsani ham inkor qiladi. Moreover qo‘shimcha dalilni kiritadi. 25.18: However ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulay olmaydi. Uning oldidan nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul qo‘yish to‘g‘ri. Tinglash — «Should the Shared Desk Trial Continue?»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. 6.1 · Present Simple — positive: I / you / we / they: I study English every day.
6.2 · Present Simple — positive: he / she / it: She studies English every day.
6.3 · Third person spelling — -s / -es / -ies: works; watches; studies

6.6 · Present Simple — negative: doesn’t: She doesn’t work on Sundays.
6.7 · Present Simple — questions: do: Do you study here?
6.8 · Present Simple — questions: does: Does he study here?
6.9 · Present Simple — wh-questions: Where do you live? When does she work?

6.11 · Question words — what / where / when: What do you do? When do you start?
6.12 · Habits and repeated actions: We visit our grandmother every week.
6.13 · Facts and general truths: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
6.14 · Frequency adverbs — gapdagi joyi: She often reads. She is always busy.
6.15 · Frequency phrases — how often: twice a week; every morning
6.16 · Be vs do / does — savol va inkor: Are you tired? / Do you work?

7.2 · Present Continuous — negative: They aren’t sleeping.
7.3 · Present Continuous — yes/no questions: Are you listening?

Bir xil xato qilgan juftlarni birlashtiring, so‘ng yangi parallel misol bilan qayta tekshiring. 5.12: Have got inkorida not have dan keyin keladi. 5.13: Have ega oldiga chiqadi; do ishlatilmaydi. 5.14: Buyruq gap asosiy fe’lning oddiy shakli bilan boshlanadi. 5.15: Salbiy buyruq do not va oddiy fe’l bilan tuziladi. 5.16: Let's dan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli order keladi. 6.1: They bilan ijobiy gapda fe’lga -s qo‘shilmaydi. 6.2: My uncle uchinchi shaxs birlik, buy ga -s qo‘shiladi. 6.3: Wash -sh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun -es qo‘shiladi. 6.4: Have ning uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli has. 6.5: We bilan do not va fe’lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi. 6.6: Does not dan keyin wears emas, wear keladi. 6.7: You bilan Present Simple savoli do yordamida tuziladi. 6.8: Does ega oldidan keladi, drives esa drive ga aylanadi. 6.9: Joy where bilan so‘raladi; uchinchi shaxsda does va work kerak. 6.10: Do you savoliga suhbatdosh I do deb javob beradi. 6.11: At six vaqtni bildiradi; savol when bilan boshlanadi. 6.12: Every winter takroriy odatni bildiradi; we bilan make ishlatiladi. 6.13: Umumiy haqiqat Present Simple bilan ifodalanadi; Earth birlik. 6.14: Often asosiy fe’ldan oldin keladi. 6.15: Three times takrorlar sonini, a week vaqt oralig‘ini bildiradi. 6.16: At home joy holati; asosiy harakat fe’li yo‘q, shuning uchun is kerak. 7.1: The children ko‘plik, shuning uchun are va building ishlatiladi. 7.2: Inkor uchun is dan keyin not qo‘yiladi. 7.3: Is ega oldiga chiqadi; carrying o‘zgarmaydi. O‘qish — «A Kitchen Changes Its Routine»: avval mazmunni ayttiring, so‘ng har javob yonida matndagi dalilni belgilang. Tinglash — «Temporary Checks at a Bicycle Hire Desk»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. Oldindan: leftovers — ortgan ovqat; scraps — yaroqsiz qoldiq; circulation — foydalanish aylanmasi. Spiral: usually/every bilan now/this month ni ajrating. Don't ko‘rsatmasini doesn't odat inkori bilan solishtiring. O‘qish: da’vo va dalilni alohida belgilang; xulosa savolida dalil zanjirini ayttiring. Tinglash: matnni yopib ikki marta o‘qing, avval pozitsiyalar, keyin tafsilotlar. Sekin o‘quvchiga argument xaritasi va 45 soniya qo‘shimcha vaqt bering. Kuchli o‘quvchi muallif xulosasining chegarasini aytib, yangi dalil qanday qarorni o‘zgartirishini tushuntirsin. Bu alohida ichki mashq, rasmiy imtihon yoki standart ball va’dasi emas. Gapirish vazifasi: Oshxona chiqindi sinovini baholang: raqamni yaxshilash va haqiqiy xizmatni yaxshilash farqini tushuntiring. 2 daqiqa fikr bildiring, keyin sherikning qarshi savoliga 30 soniyada javob bering. Yozish vazifasi: Jamoat oshxonasi xabari: bir oylik chiqindi o‘lchovi va kichik dastlabki porsiyalar sinovi rejalangan, ko‘ngillilar fikri so‘ralgan. Do‘stingiz Umidga munosabat, tashvish va yordam rejangiz haqida email yozing. 45–55 so‘z yozing. Tayyor yozuv namunasini dastlabki urinishdan keyin ko‘rsating; nusxa ko‘chirishni mustaqil natija deb baholamang.
checkQuestions: Inkor qiling: I have got a charger. [Javob: I have not got a charger. / I haven't got a charger. / I've not got a charger.. Have got inkorida not have dan keyin keladi.]
Have got savoliga aylantiring: You have got a bicycle. [Javob: Have you got a bicycle?. Have ega oldiga chiqadi; do ishlatilmaydi.]
Buyruqni to‘ldiring: ___ your name at the top. (Write / Writes) [Javob: Write. Buyruq gap asosiy fe’lning oddiy shakli bilan boshlanadi.]
Salbiy buyruqqa aylantiring: Touch the wet paint. [Javob: Do not touch the wet paint. / Don't touch the wet paint.. Salbiy buyruq do not va oddiy fe’l bilan tuziladi.]
Let's bilan taklif yozing: «Pitsa buyurtiraylik». [Javob: Let's order pizza.. Let's dan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli order keladi.]
Present Simple: They ___ the floor every Friday. (clean) [Javob: clean. They bilan ijobiy gapda fe’lga -s qo‘shilmaydi.]
Present Simple: My uncle ___ bread every morning. (buy) [Javob: buys. My uncle uchinchi shaxs birlik, buy ga -s qo‘shiladi.]
He bilan ishlatish uchun wash fe’lining shaklini yozing. [Javob: washes. Wash -sh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun -es qo‘shiladi.]
Present Simple: My cousin ___ a red scooter. (have) [Javob: has. Have ning uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli has.]
Inkor qiling: We eat meat. [Javob: We do not eat meat. / We don't eat meat.. We bilan do not va fe’lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi.]
Inkor qiling: My sister wears glasses. [Javob: My sister does not wear glasses. / My sister doesn't wear glasses.. Does not dan keyin wears emas, wear keladi.]
Yes/no savol tuzing: You collect stamps. [Javob: Do you collect stamps?. You bilan Present Simple savoli do yordamida tuziladi.]
Yes/no savol tuzing: Nina drives to work. [Javob: Does Nina drive to work?. Does ega oldidan keladi, drives esa drive ga aylanadi.]
Where bilan savol tuzing: Omar works in a bakery. Joyni so‘rang. [Javob: Where does Omar work?. Joy where bilan so‘raladi; uchinchi shaxsda does va work kerak.]
Qisqa ijobiy javob yozing: Do you enjoy gardening? [Javob: Yes, I do.. Do you savoliga suhbatdosh I do deb javob beradi.]
Savol so‘zini tanlang: ___ do you finish work? — At six. (What / Where / When) [Javob: When. At six vaqtni bildiradi; savol when bilan boshlanadi.]
Odatni ifodalang: Every winter, we ___ scarves for our cousins. (make) [Javob: make. Every winter takroriy odatni bildiradi; we bilan make ishlatiladi.]
Umumiy haqiqat: The Earth ___ around the Sun. (move) [Javob: moves. Umumiy haqiqat Present Simple bilan ifodalanadi; Earth birlik.]
Often ni odatiy o‘ringa qo‘ying: He visits his aunt. [Javob: He often visits his aunt.. Often asosiy fe’ldan oldin keladi.]
«Haftasiga uch marta» iborasini inglizcha yozing. [Javob: three times a week. Three times takrorlar sonini, a week vaqt oralig‘ini bildiradi.]
Tanlang: ___ your brother at home? (Is / Does) [Javob: Is. At home joy holati; asosiy harakat fe’li yo‘q, shuning uchun is kerak.]
Present Continuous: The children ___ a snowman. (build) [Javob: are building. The children ko‘plik, shuning uchun are va building ishlatiladi.]

Inkor qiling: She is washing the car. [Javob: She is not washing the car. / She isn't washing the car. / She's not washing the car. / She has not washing the car. / She hasn't washing the car.. Inkor uchun is dan keyin not qo‘yiladi.]
Yes/no savolga aylantiring: He is carrying a ladder. [Javob: Is he carrying a ladder?. Is ega oldiga chiqadi; carrying o‘zgarmaydi.]
Reading · A Kitchen Changes Its Routine: How often does the kitchen serve lunch? [Javob: four days a week / 4 days a week. Dalil: «four days a week». Javob matnda bevosita berilgan.]

Listening · Temporary Checks at a Bicycle Hire Desk: When are bicycles normally inspected? [Javob: at the end of each hour / hourly / every hour / the end of each hour / end of each hour. Dalil: «at the end of each hour». Javob suhbatdagi shu ma’lumotga tayanadi.]
commonMistake: O‘zbekcha tartibni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang. Inglizcha sodda gapda fe’lni tushirib qoldirmang. He a teacher emas — He is a teacher. Are you happy? savoliga Yes, I am deb javob beriladi. An university, informations, two childs o‘rniga a university, information, two children. Mine book emas — my book. She knows he emas — She knows him. Does she has emas — Does she have. There have emas — There is/are. She don’t, Does she works o‘rniga She doesn’t, Does she work. I am knowing emas — I know. She working emas — She is working. In Monday emas — on Monday. Where you live emas — Where do you live? Bugungi tuzatish namunasi: Inkor qiling: She has got a passport. → She has not got a passport. / She hasn't got a passport. / She's not got a passport.. Has got inkorida has not got ishlatiladi.
differentiation: Tayanch: «A Kitchen Changes Its Routine» savollarini bittadan bering, ikkita javob variantidan tanlating; doskadagi «5.12 · Have got — negative: I haven’t got a car.» modelini ko‘rinadigan qoldiring. Gapni boshlash va dalil joyini topish uchun juftlik yordami bering. Kengaytirish: «Temporary Checks at a Bicycle Hire Desk»dagi javobni matndan dalil bilan izohlatsin; «Present Continuous — yes/no questions» bo‘yicha ikkinchi vaziyat yaratsin va ma’no yoki shakl tanlovini asoslasin.

checkQuestions: Where bilan savol tuzing: They are having lunch in the garden. Joyni so‘rang. [Javob: Where are they having lunch?. Where dan keyin are, ega va -ing shakli keladi.]
Qisqa ijobiy javob yozing: Are you wearing a hat? [Javob: Yes, I am.. Are you savoliga I am bilan javob beriladi; ijobiy qisqa javobda I'm yolg‘iz ishlatilmaydi.]
Bake fe’lining -ing shaklini yozing. [Javob: baking. Oxirgi talaffuz qilinmaydigan e tushib, -ing qo‘shiladi.]
Sit fe’lining -ing shaklini yozing. [Javob: sitting. Qisqa urg‘uli unli va bitta undosh bilan tugagani uchun t ikkilantiriladi.]
Hozirgi harakat: Look! A squirrel ___ our nuts. (eat) [Javob: is eating. Look hozir sodir bo‘layotgan ishga ishora qiladi; is eating kerak.]

Vaqtinchalik holat: We ___ with friends until our kitchen is repaired. (stay; Present Continuous) [Javob: are staying. Ta’mir tugaguncha davom etadigan vaqtinchalik holat are staying bilan ifodalanadi.]
O‘zgarishni ifodalang: My little brother ___ taller every month. (get; Present Continuous) [Javob: is getting. Davom etayotgan o‘zgarish is getting bilan ifodalanadi; t ikkilantiriladi.]

Ikki shaklni tartib bilan yozing: I usually ___ tea, but today I ___ coffee. (drink; have) [Javob: drink, am having. Usually odat uchun Present Simple; today dagi vaqtinchalik holat uchun Present Continuous.]
Xatoni tuzatib yozing: I am believing you. [Javob: I believe you.. Believe holat fe’li bo‘lib, bu ma’noda odatda Continuous bilan ishlatilmaydi.]
Cheklangan tanlovni so‘rang: ___ of these two jackets is yours? (What / Which) [Javob: Which. Ma’lum ikkita narsa orasidagi tanlov uchun which ishlatiladi.]
Tanlang: ___ repaired your bicycle? — My uncle. (Who / Whose) [Javob: Who. Ishni bajargan shaxs who bilan so‘raladi.]
Savol so‘zini yozing: ___ are you carrying an umbrella? — Because rain is expected. [Javob: Why. Because bilan javob sababni bildiradi, shuning uchun why kerak.]
Mos savol iborasini yozing: ___ is your nephew? — He's eight. [Javob: How old. Yosh how old bilan so‘raladi.]
Bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: ___ flour do we need? [Javob: How much. Flour sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun how much.]
Ega haqida Who bilan savol tuzing: Maya feeds the rabbits. [Javob: Who feeds the rabbits?. Who eganing o‘rnini egallaydi; do yoki does qo‘shilmaydi.]
To‘ldiruvchi haqida Who bilan savol tuzing: You visit your grandmother on Sundays. [Javob: Who do you visit on Sundays?. Who to‘ldiruvchini so‘raydi, shuning uchun do yordamchisi kerak.]
Tanlang: The coins are ___ my pocket. (in / on / at) [Javob: in. Cho‘ntak ichidagi narsalar uchun in ishlatiladi.]
Tanlang: The bank is ___ the café and the bakery. (under / between / behind) [Javob: between. Ikkita joy orasida bo‘lsa between kerak.]
Tanlang: She stepped ___ the kitchen from the hall. (into / at) [Javob: into. Tashqaridan ichkariga harakat uchun into ishlatiladi.]
Ikki predlogni tartib bilan yozing: The lesson starts ___ ten ___ Thursday. [Javob: at, on. Soat oldidan at, hafta kuni oldidan on ishlatiladi.]
Tanlang: Wash your hands ___ eating. (before / until) [Javob: before. Ovqatlanishdan avvalgi harakat uchun before kerak.]
Ikki bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: The library is open ___ eight ___ four. [Javob: from, to. Boshlanish va tugash nuqtalari from ... to bilan ko‘rsatiladi.]
Careful so‘zidan ravish yasang: Please carry the vase ___. [Javob: carefully. Harakatning qanday bajarilishini careful + ly, ya’ni carefully bildiradi.]
Tanlang: My aunt sings very ___. (good / well) [Javob: well. Sing fe’lini tavsiflash uchun good ning ravish shakli well kerak.]

Ravish → joy → vaqt tartibida gap yozing: Tom practised / yesterday / in his room / quietly. [Javob: Tom practised quietly in his room yesterday.. Bu topshiriqda quietly harakat usuli, in his room joy, yesterday vaqt sifatida ketma-ket keladi.]

Reading · The Delivery Map Needs Better Questions: What street does the route cross? [Javob: a busy market street / the market street / market street / busy market street. Dalil: «a busy market street». Javob matnda bevosita berilgan.]

Listening · A Visitor Information Desk Reviews Its Signs: What is the room behind? [Javob: a fire door / the fire door / fire door. Dalil: «behind a fire door». Javob suhbatdagi shu ma’lumotga tayanadi.]
commonMistake: O‘zbekcha tartibni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang. Inglizcha sodda gapda fe’lni tushirib qoldirmang. He a teacher emas — He is a teacher. Are you happy? savoliga Yes, I am deb javob beriladi. An university, informations, two childs o‘rniga a university, information, two children. Mine book emas — my book. She knows he emas — She knows him. Does she has emas — Does she have. There have emas — There is/are. She don’t, Does she works o‘rniga She doesn’t, Does she work. I am knowing emas — I know. She working emas — She is working. In Monday emas — on Monday. Where you live emas — Where do you live? Bugungi tuzatish namunasi: What bilan savol tuzing: Lena is painting a chair. Bo‘yayotgan narsani so‘rang. → What is Lena painting?. What to‘ldiruvchini so‘raydi; is ega oldida turadi.
differentiation: Tayanch: «The Delivery Map Needs Better Questions» savollarini bittadan bering, ikkita javob variantidan tanlating; doskadagi «7.4 · Present Continuous — wh-questions: What is she doing?» modelini ko‘rinadigan qoldiring. board: 1.1 · Noun — ot nima?: student, book, school
1.2 · Adjective — sifat nima?: kind, happy, useful
1.3 · Verb — harakat va holat fe’li: read, work, be
1.4 · Pronoun — ot o‘rnidagi so‘z: Ali → he; the book → it
1.5 · Adverb — ravish nima?: slowly, often, here
1.6 · Preposition — predlog nima?: in the room; at school
1.7 · Conjunction — bog‘lovchi nima?: and, but, because
1.8 · Subject pronouns — ega olmoshlari: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
1.9 · Subject — gapning egasi: My sister works.
1.10 · Verb / object — fe’l va to‘ldiruvchi: I read books.
1.11 · Complement — egani tavsiflovchi qism: She is a teacher. She is kind.
1.12 · Word order — ega + fe’l + davom: We study English at school.
1.13 · Be va harakat fe’lini ajratish: I am happy. / I work. (I am work emas.)
1.14 · Capital letters va gap oxiri: I am Ali. Are you ready?
2.1 · Am / is / are — egaga moslash: I am; he/she/it is; you/we/they are
2.2 · To be + adjective — positive: She is happy.
2.3 · To be + adjective — negative: She is not happy.
2.4 · To be + adjective — questions: Is she happy?
2.5 · To be + noun — positive: He is a student.
2.6 · To be + noun — negative: He is not a student.
2.7 · To be + noun — questions: Is he a student?
2.8 · To be + adjective + noun — positive: She is a kind teacher.
2.9 · To be + adjective + noun — negative: She is not a kind teacher.
2.10 · To be + adjective + noun — questions: Is she a kind teacher?
2.11 · To be + place — positive: They are at school.
2.12 · To be + place — negative: They are not at school.
2.13 · To be + place — questions: Are they at school?
2.14 · Wh-questions with be: Who is he? Where are you? How are you?
2.15 · Short answers — qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, she isn’t.
2.16 · Contractions — qisqartmalar: I’m; she’s; we’re; isn’t; aren’t
2.17 · Birlikdagi noun bilan a / an: a teacher; an English teacher
2.18 · Place phrases va here / there: at home; in class; She is here.
3.1 · Singular nouns — birlik: a book; a student
3.2 · Regular plurals — -s / -es: books; boxes
3.3 · Plural spelling — -y / -f shakllari: city → cities; leaf → leaves
3.4 · Irregular plurals — istisnolar: child → children; person → people
3.5 · Countable nouns — sanaladigan otlar: one apple; two apples
3.6 · Uncountable nouns — sanalmaydigan otlar: water; advice; information
3.7 · A / an — tovushga qarab tanlash: a university; an hour
3.8 · A / an — birinchi marta tilga olish: I bought a bag.
3.9 · The — ma’lum yoki aniqlangan narsa: The bag is blue.
3.10 · Zero article — umumiy ko‘plik: Books are useful.
3.11 · Zero article — umumiy sanalmaydigan ot: Water is important.
3.12 · Articles with jobs — kasblar: She is an engineer.
3.13 · Possessive ’s — birlikdagi egalik: my brother’s phone
3.14 · Possessive s’ — ko‘plikdagi egalik: the students’ books
3.15 · Partitives — miqdor birikmalari: a piece of advice; a glass of water
3.16 · Compound nouns — qo‘shma otlar: bus stop; classroom; coffee cup
4.1 · Object pronouns — to‘ldiruvchi olmoshlar: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
4.2 · Subject vs object pronouns: She knows him. He knows her.
4.3 · Possessive adjectives — my / your…: This is my book.
4.4 · Possessive pronouns — mine / yours…: This book is mine.
4.5 · Possessive adjective vs pronoun: your bag / yours
4.6 · This / that — birlikka ishora: This is my pen. That is your bag.
4.7 · These / those — ko‘plikka ishora: These are books. Those are pens.
4.8 · Whose — kimniki?: Whose bag is this?
4.9 · One / ones — otni takrorlamaslik: The blue one. / The small ones.
4.10 · Somebody / anybody / nobody: Somebody is here. Nobody is outside.
4.11 · Something / anything / nothing: I need something. I don’t need anything.
4.12 · Every / each — har biri: Every student has a book.
4.13 · Reflexive pronouns — o‘zlik: I made it myself.
4.14 · Each other — o‘zaro harakat: They help each other.
5.1 · There is — positive: There is a library nearby.
5.2 · There are — positive: There are two windows.
5.3 · There is / are — negative: There isn’t a lift. There aren’t any chairs.
5.4 · There is / are — yes/no questions: Is there a bank? Are there any shops?
5.5 · There is / are — how many questions: How many rooms are there?
5.6 · There is / are — short answers: Yes, there is. / No, there aren’t.
5.7 · There vs it — borlik va ishora: There is a park. It is large.
5.8 · Have / has — positive: I have a bike. She has a car.
5.9 · Have / has — negative: I don’t have a car. He doesn’t have a bike.
5.10 · Have / has — questions: Do you have a pen? Does she have a car?
5.11 · Have got / has got — positive: I’ve got a bag. She’s got a phone.
5.12 · Have got — negative: I haven’t got a car.
5.13 · Have got — questions and short answers: Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.
5.14 · Imperative — positive: Open your book, please.
5.15 · Imperative — negative: Don’t close the door.
5.16 · Let’s / let’s not — taklif: Let’s start. Let’s not wait.
6.1 · Present Simple — positive: I / you / we / they: I study English every day.
6.2 · Present Simple — positive: he / she / it: She studies English every day.
6.3 · Third person spelling — -s / -es / -ies: works; watches; studies
6.4 · Third person — irregular forms: has; does; goes
6.5 · Present Simple — negative: don’t: I don’t work on Sundays.
6.6 · Present Simple — negative: doesn’t: She doesn’t work on Sundays.
6.7 · Present Simple — questions: do: Do you study here?
6.8 · Present Simple — questions: does: Does he study here?
6.9 · Present Simple — wh-questions: Where do you live? When does she work?
6.10 · Present Simple — short answers: Yes, I do. / No, he doesn’t.
6.11 · Question words — what / where / when: What do you do? When do you start?
6.12 · Habits and repeated actions: We visit our grandmother every week.
6.13 · Facts and general truths: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
6.14 · Frequency adverbs — gapdagi joyi: She often reads. She is always busy.
6.15 · Frequency phrases — how often: twice a week; every morning
6.16 · Be vs do / does — savol va inkor: Are you tired? / Do you work?
7.1 · Present Continuous — positive: I am reading. She is working.
7.2 · Present Continuous — negative: They aren’t sleeping.
7.3 · Present Continuous — yes/no questions: Are you listening?
7.4 · Present Continuous — wh-questions: What is she doing?
7.5 · Present Continuous — short answers: Yes, I am. / No, they aren’t.
7.6 · -ing spelling — asosiy qoida: work → working; make → making
7.7 · -ing spelling — doubling / -ie: run → running; lie → lying
7.8 · Actions happening now: He is talking on the phone now.
7.9 · Temporary situations: I am staying with my aunt this week.
7.10 · Changes and trends: The weather is getting warmer.
7.11 · Present Simple vs Continuous: I walk to school. / I’m taking a taxi today.
7.12 · Stative verbs — asosiy holatlar: I know the answer. (I am knowing emas.)
8.1 · What / which — ochiq va cheklangan tanlov: What music do you like? Which bag is yours?
8.2 · Who / whose — kim va kimniki?: Who is she? Whose phone is this?
8.3 · Why / how — sabab va usul: Why do you study? How do you travel?
8.4 · How old / how long / how far: How old are you? How far is the station?
8.5 · How much / how many: How much water? How many books?
8.6 · Subject questions — who + verb: Who lives here?
8.7 · Object questions — yordamchi bilan: Who do you know here?
8.8 · Place — in / on / at: in the room; on the table; at the station
8.9 · Position — under / behind / between…: The bag is under the chair.
8.10 · Movement — to / into / out of / across: She walks into the room.
8.11 · Time — in / on / at: in May; on Monday; at six
8.12 · Time — before / after / until: before class; after lunch; until Friday
8.13 · From…to / during / for: from nine to five; during class; for an hour
8.14 · Adverbs of manner — -ly: She speaks slowly.
8.15 · Adverbs — irregular forms: good → well; fast → fast
8.16 · Place–manner–time: tabiiy gap tartibi: She worked quietly at home yesterday.

commonMistake: Did you went emas — Did you go. I didn’t was emas — I wasn’t. Did you used to emas — Did you use to. O‘tgan doimiy holat uchun would ni avtomatik ishlatmang. When I will arrive emas — when I arrive. I going to emas — I am going to. I have went emas — I have gone. I have seen it yesterday o‘rniga I saw it yesterday. Perfect shakllarda have/had va V3 ni tushirib qoldirmang; barcha fe’llarni continuous ga aylantirmang. Bugungi tuzatish namunasi: Bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: You ___ at the concert last night. (was / were) → were. You bilan o‘tgan zamon be shakli were bo‘ladi.

O‘qish — «The Parcel on the Wrong Shelf»: avval mazmunni ayttiring, so‘ng har javob yonida matndagi dalilni belgilang. Tinglash — «Before the Evening Lecture»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. Oldindan: courier — yetkazuvchi; accusation — ayblov; replacement — almashtiruvchi narsa. Matnda fakt va taxmin ranglarini belgilang. Tinglashni birinchi marta muammo, ikkinchisida noto‘g‘ri taxminlar uchun o‘qing. Qiynaluvchiga ishonch darajasi shkalasini bering; kuchli o‘quvchi qat’iy ayblovni dalilga mos ehtiyotkor savolga aylantirsin. Bu ichki kurs amaliyoti; rasmiy test yoki standart ball emas. Gapirish vazifasi: Tez choralar ko‘rish va avval dalilni tekshirish orasida qanday muvozanat kerak? 2 daqiqa davomida argument, dalil, qarshi argument va unga javob bering. Yozish vazifasi: Forumga ishdagi taxminlar haqida post yozing. Kamera misolini tahlil qiling, tez harakat qilish foydasini tan oling va tekshirish tartibini taklif qiling. 180–200 so‘z yozing. Tayyor yozuv namunasini dastlabki urinishdan keyin ko‘rsating; nusxa ko‘chirishni mustaqil natija deb baholamang.
checkQuestions: Have to ni o‘tgan zamonga qo‘ying: Last night we ___ use candles. [Javob: had to. O‘tgan majburiyat barcha egalar bilan had to orqali ifodalanadi.]
Have to ni Past Simple inkorga qo‘ying: The lift worked, so we ___ climb the stairs. [Javob: did not have to / didn't have to. O‘tgan zamonda zarurat yo‘qligi didn't have to bilan aytiladi.]
Will have to bilan to‘ldiring: When the pass expires, I ___ renew it. [Javob: will have to / 'll have to. Kelajakda paydo bo‘ladigan zarurat will have to bilan ifodalanadi.]
A yoki B: Dubulg‘a kiyish shart, uni yechish mumkin emas. A) You mustn't remove it. B) You don't have to remove it. [Javob: A. Taqiq uchun mustn't ishlatiladi.]
Should yordamida maslahatni to‘ldiring: Your bag is heavy. You ___ (use) a trolley. [Javob: should use. Maslahat uchun should + asosiy fe’l; use shakli o‘zgarmaydi.]
Should ning inkorini yozing: This shelf is weak. You ___ put heavy boxes on it. [Javob: should not / shouldn't. Shouldn't qilmaslik haqidagi maslahatni bildiradi.]
Maslahat so‘rovchi savolni tanlang: A) Which entrance should we use? B) Which entrance we should use? [Javob: A. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri savolda should egadan oldin keladi.]
Faqat predlogni yozing: You ought ___ check the address first. [Javob: to. Ought to dan keyin asosiy fe’l keladi.]
Need to ni moslang: This plant ___ more sunlight. Bo‘shliqqa need to get birikmasini moslab yozing. [Javob: needs to get. Birlikdagi this plant bilan needs to get ishlatiladi.]

A yoki B: Men chipta sotib oldim, keyin kirish bepul ekanini bildim. A) I needn't have bought a ticket. B) I didn't need to buy a ticket, so I didn't. [Javob: A. Needn't have bought bajarilgan, ammo keraksiz bo‘lgan harakatni bildiradi.]
Hozirgi ehtimol uchun may/might/could dan mosini yozing: I am not sure, but the keys ___ be in the garage. [Javob: may / might / could. Uchala modal ham bu gapda hozirgi ehtimolni bildiradi.]
May bilan ehtimoliy inkorni yozing: Perhaps Sara does not recognise us. Sara ___ recognise us. [Javob: may not. May not ehtimol tanimasligini bildiradi, qat’iy taqiqni emas.]
Must orqali hozirgi kuchli taxminni yozing: Ali has worked three night shifts. He ___ (be) exhausted. [Javob: must be. Hozirgi holatga dalil asosidagi kuchli taxmin must + be orqali ifodalanadi.]
Can't bilan kuchli inkoriy taxmin: That ___ be our bus; its number is wrong. [Javob: cannot / can't. Can't be dalil asosida bu holat mumkin emasligini bildiradi.]

Hozirgi ehtimol haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Could that noise be the washing machine? B) Could be that noise the washing machine? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi could + ega + be; be egadan keyin keladi.]
Qavsdagi fe’lni davom etayotgan ehtimolga qo‘ying: Dad might ___ (sleep) upstairs now. [Javob: be sleeping. Modal + be + -ing ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.]
Must have bilan to‘ldiring: The grass is wet, though nobody watered it. It ___ (rain) overnight. [Javob: must have rained. O‘tgan voqeaga kuchli taxmin: must have + V3.]
Might have bilan to‘ldiring: Perhaps I sent the letter to the old address. I ___ (send) it there. [Javob: might have sent. Might have + V3 o‘tgan ehtimolni bildiradi.]
Reading · The Parcel on the Wrong Shelf: Where was the camera found? [Javob: on the urgent shelf / the urgent shelf / a shelf marked urgent / urgent shelf. «on a shelf marked urgent» topilgan joy.]

Listening · Before the Evening Lecture: How many chairs were behind the screen? [Javob: 20 / twenty / twenty chairs / 20 chairs. «twenty chairs waiting behind the screen» haqiqiy zaxirani ko‘rsatadi.]
commonMistake: More better emas — better. Enough ot oldida, sifatdan keyin: enough time, old enough. Can to swim emas — can swim. She cans emas — she can. Mustn’t va don’t have to ni almashtirmang. Should to emas — should + fe’l. Must had emas — must have. Should have done ni hozirgi maslahat bilan aralashtirmang. Odatdagi First conditional da if I will emas — if I do. If oldinda bo‘lsa, ikki qism orasiga vergul. I wish I have emas — I wish I had. Wish va hope ni ma’nosiga qarab ajrating. checkQuestions: Can't have bilan to‘ldiring: The parcel arrived ten minutes ago. You ___ (collect) it yesterday. [Javob: cannot have collected / can't have collected. Can't have + V3 o‘tgan harakatning imkonsizligi haqidagi xulosadir.]
Should have bilan afsusni to‘ldiring: I got lost. I ___ (save) the map before leaving. [Javob: should have saved. Should have saved qilish yaxshi bo‘lgan, ammo qilinmagan ishni bildiradi.]

Shouldn't have bilan to‘ldiring: I told everyone her secret. I ___ (say) anything. [Javob: should not have said / shouldn't have said. Shouldn't have said bajarilgan, ammo noto‘g‘ri bo‘lgan ishga afsusdir.]
Could have bilan to‘ldiring: A neighbour offered a lift, but we walked. We ___ (accept) it. [Javob: could have accepted. Could have accepted mavjud, ammo ishlatilmagan imkoniyatni bildiradi.]
Ehtimol yuqoriligini bildiring: The weather looks excellent. The picnic is ___ go ahead. A) likely to B) unlikely to [Javob: A. Be likely to hodisa yuz berishi ehtimoli yuqoriligini bildiradi.]

To‘g‘ri joylashuvni tanlang: A) She will probably find the key. B) She will find probably the key. [Javob: A. Probably yordamchi fe’ldan keyin, asosiy fe’ldan oldin kelishi mumkin; fe’l bilan obyektni ajratmaymiz.]
Umumiy qonuniyat, Zero Conditional: If this sensor detects smoke, the alarm ___ (ring). [Javob: rings. Zero Conditionalning ikkala qismida Present Simple ishlatiladi.]
Zero Conditional inkori: If the battery ___ (not work), the clock stops. [Javob: does not work / doesn't work. Birlikdagi battery bilan doesn't work; bu umumiy holat.]
Umumiy qonuniyat savoli: What ___ (happen) if milk gets too warm? [Javob: happens. What ega vazifasida kelgan; sodda hozirgi zamonda happens kerak.]
First Conditional, will bilan: If the rain stops, we ___ (eat) outside. [Javob: will eat / 'll eat. Real kelajak sharti: if + Present Simple, natija will + fe’l.]
First Conditional, will inkori: If the lift breaks, we ___ (not use) it. [Javob: will not use / won't use. Natija qismida will not + asosiy fe’l ishlatiladi.]

Real kelajak sharti haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Will you help if we run out of chairs? B) You will help if we run out of chairs? [Javob: A. Odatiy yozma yes/no savolda will egadan oldin keladi.]

Real kelajak sharti haqidagi odatiy wh-savolni tanlang: A) Where you will wait if the hall is locked? B) Where will you wait if the hall is locked? [Javob: B. Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + asosiy fe’l tartibi kerak.]
Buyruq shaklini yozing: If the screen freezes, ___ (restart) the app. [Javob: restart. Shartning natijasi buyruq bo‘lsa, asosiy fe’l ishlatiladi.]
Bitta bog‘lovchi: ___ you bring your pass, you won't get in. Ma’no: agar olib kelmasangiz. [Javob: Unless. Unless bu yerda if you do not ma’nosini beradi.]
Second Conditional: If I owned a boat, I ___ (visit) the island. Would dan foydalaning. [Javob: would visit / 'd visit. Faraziy hozirgi yoki kelajak natija would + fe’l bilan tuziladi.]
Second Conditional: If I ___ (not live) nearby, I would take a bus. [Javob: did not live / didn't live. If qismida Past Simple inkori: didn't + asosiy fe’l.]

16.12 · Shouldn’t — negative: You shouldn’t skip meals.
16.13 · Should — questions: What should I do? Should I call her?
16.14 · Ought to / had better: You ought to rest. We’d better leave.
16.15 · Need to / don’t need to / needn’t: You needn’t hurry.
16.16 · Needn’t have vs didn’t need to: I needn’t have bought bread; we already had some.
17.1 · May / might / could — hozirgi ehtimol: She might be at home.
17.2 · May not / might not — ehtimoliy inkor: He might not know the answer.
17.3 · Must — hozirgi kuchli taxmin: The lights are on. They must be home.
17.4 · Can’t — hozirgi imkonsiz taxmin: He can’t be at school; it’s closed.
17.5 · Could…? — ehtimol haqida savol: Could this be the right address?
17.6 · Modal + be + -ing: She might be working now.
17.7 · Must have + V3 — o‘tgan kuchli taxmin: They must have missed the bus.
17.8 · May / might / could have + V3: She might have forgotten the date.
17.9 · Can’t / couldn’t have + V3: He can’t have finished already.
17.10 · Should have + V3 — bajarilmagan yaxshi ish: I should have studied earlier.
17.11 · Shouldn’t have + V3 — afsus: I shouldn’t have said that.
17.12 · Could have + V3 — foydalanilmagan imkon: We could have taken a taxi, but we walked.
17.13 · Be likely / unlikely to: Prices are likely to rise.
17.14 · Probably / definitely — gapdagi joyi: She will probably come. He probably won’t.
18.1 · Zero conditional — positive: If you heat ice, it melts.
18.2 · Zero conditional — negative: If plants don’t get water, they die.
18.3 · Zero conditional — questions: What happens if you heat ice?
18.4 · First conditional — positive: If I finish early, I’ll call you.
18.5 · First conditional — negative: If it rains, we won’t go out.
18.6 · First conditional — yes/no questions: Will you come if you are free?
18.7 · First conditional — wh-questions: What will you do if it rains?
18.8 · First conditional — modal / imperative result: If you’re tired, rest. If you finish, you can leave.
18.9 · Unless — if…not: Unless you hurry, you’ll miss the bus.
18.10 · Second conditional — positive: If I had more time, I would travel.
18.11 · Second conditional — negative: If I didn’t work, I wouldn’t earn money.
18.12 · Second conditional — yes/no questions: Would you move if you found a better job?
18.13 · Second conditional — wh-questions: What would you do if you won?
18.14 · If I were you — maslahat: If I were you, I would ask for help.
18.15 · First vs second conditional: If I have time… / If I had more time…
18.16 · If-clause order and commas: If it rains, we’ll stay. / We’ll stay if it rains.
19.1 · Third conditional — positive: If I had studied, I would have passed.
19.2 · Third conditional — negative: If we hadn’t left late, we wouldn’t have missed it.
19.3 · Third conditional — yes/no questions: Would you have come if I had invited you?
19.4 · Third conditional — wh-questions: What would you have done if you had known?
19.5 · Third conditional — could / might have: If I had saved more, I could have bought it.
19.6 · Mixed conditional — past → present: If I had slept well, I wouldn’t be tired now.
19.7 · Mixed conditional — present → past: If I spoke French, I would have understood her.
19.8 · Mixed conditional — negative / questions: Would you be here if you hadn’t met her?
19.9 · Wish / if only + Past Simple: I wish I had more time.
19.10 · Wish / if only + Past Perfect: I wish I had listened.
19.11 · Wish + would — o‘zgarishini istash: I wish the neighbours would be quieter.
19.12 · Wish + could — imkon yoki qobiliyat: I wish I could swim.
19.13 · Wish vs hope: I hope she comes. / I wish she were here.
19.14 · Provided / as long as / even if: You can borrow it as long as you return it.

checkQuestions: Qiyosiy shakl: This suitcase is ___ than mine. (heavy) [Javob: heavier. Undosh + y bilan tugagan heavy qiyosiy shaklda heavier bo‘ladi.]
Qiyosiy shakl: This chair is ___ than that stool. (comfortable) [Javob: more comfortable. Uzun sifat oldidan more qo‘yiladi.]
Qiyosiy shakl: My cough is ___ today than yesterday. (bad) [Javob: worse. Bad ning noto‘g‘ri qiyosiy shakli worse.]
Orttirma shakl, artikl bilan: This is ___ room in the house. (small) [Javob: the smallest. Orttirma darajada the va -est ishlatiladi.]
Orttirma shakl, artikl bilan: It was ___ meal of the week. (bad) [Javob: the worst. Bad ning orttirma shakli the worst.]
Ikki bo‘shliqni tartib bilan to‘ldiring: My bag is ___ heavy ___ yours. Ularning vazni bir xil. [Javob: as, as. Tenglik as + sifat + as bilan ifodalanadi.]
Ravishning qiyosiy shakli: Please speak ___ than before. (slowly) [Javob: more slowly. Ko‘p -ly ravishlari more bilan qiyoslanadi.]
Tanlang: This box is ___ heavier than that one. (very / much) [Javob: much. Qiyosiy sifatni kuchaytirish uchun much ishlatiladi, very emas.]
Tanlang: I bought ___ oranges for the picnic. (some / any) [Javob: some. Oddiy ijobiy gapda some ishlatiladi.]
Taklifni to‘ldiring: Would you like ___ juice? (some / any) [Javob: some. Ichimlik taklif qilinayotgan savolda some odatiy tanlov.]
Tanlang: How ___ luggage have you got? (much / many) [Javob: much. Luggage sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun much kerak.]
Ijobiy ma’no: We have ___ eggs, so we can make an omelette. (few / a few) [Javob: a few. A few oz bo‘lsa-da borligini, foydalanish mumkinligini ta’kidlaydi.]
Yetarli oz miqdor: There's ___ milk left, enough for one cup. (little / a little) [Javob: a little. A little oz miqdor borligini ijobiy ko‘rsatadi.]
Tanlang: This coffee is ___ hot to drink. (too / enough) [Javob: too. Too hot ortiqcha issiq, ichish uchun yaroqsiz darajani bildiradi.]
Ikkalasi ham yo‘q: ___ of these two keys opens the door. (Both / Neither) [Javob: Neither. Neither ikkita variantning hech biri mos emasligini bildiradi.]
Bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: Most ___ the guests arrived early. [Javob: of. The bilan belgilangan aniq guruh oldidan most of ishlatiladi.]
Can bilan yozing: «Singlim shaxmat o‘ynay oladi». [Javob: My sister can play chess.. Qobiliyat can va fe’lning oddiy shakli bilan ifodalanadi.]
Inkor qiling: I can lift this box. [Javob: I cannot lift this box. / I can't lift this box.. Can inkori cannot yoki can't bo‘ladi.]
Yes/no savolga aylantiring: Your aunt can sew. [Javob: Can your aunt sew?. Can ega oldiga chiqadi.]
What bilan savol tuzing: She can repair bicycles. Tuzata oladigan narsani so‘rang. [Javob: What can she repair?. What dan keyin can, ega va fe’l keladi.]
Qisqa ijobiy javob yozing: Can you juggle? [Javob: Yes, I can.. Qobiliyat savoliga qisqa ijobiy javob can bilan beriladi.]
Oldingi qobiliyat: At six, she ___ ride a bicycle. (can / could) [Javob: could. O‘tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat could bilan ifodalanadi.]
Inkor qiling: We could hear the guide. [Javob: We could not hear the guide. / We couldn't hear the guide.. Could inkori could not yoki couldn't.]
Yes/no savolga aylantiring: She could read music at eight. [Javob: Could she read music at eight?. Could ega oldiga chiqadi; read o‘zgarmaydi.]
Kelajak qobiliyati: After the lesson, you ___ use this machine. (be able to; will bilan) [Javob: will be able to. Can ning will can shakli yo‘q; will be able to ishlatiladi.]
Aniq muvaffaqiyat: After several attempts, we ___ open the stuck window. (managed to / could) [Javob: managed to. Qiyinchilikdan keyingi bitta muvaffaqiyat managed to bilan aniq ifodalanadi.]

May I bilan ruxsat so‘rang: «Bu yerda suratga olsam maylimi?» [Javob: May I take a photo here? / May I take a photograph here? / May I take photos here?. May I rasmiyroq va muloyim ruxsat so‘rash shakli.]
Could you bilan iltimos qiling: «Bu qutini ko‘tarib bera olasizmi?» Carry ishlating. [Javob: Could you carry this box?. Could you + oddiy fe’l muloyim iltimos tuzadi.]
Ruxsatni to‘ldiring: We ___ bring our own food. (be allowed to; Present Simple) [Javob: are allowed to. We bilan are allowed to ruxsat borligini bildiradi.]

Would like bilan istak bildiring: «Men deraza yonidagi stolni xohlardim». [Javob: I would like a table by the window. / I would like a table near the window. / I'd like a table by the window. / I'd like a table near the window.. Would like muloyim istak bildiradi; undan keyin ot birikmasi kelishi mumkin.]
Majburiyatni must bilan ifodalang. Faqat bo‘shliq: Visitors ___ show identification. [Javob: must. Must dan keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli keladi; qoida majburiyatni bildiradi.]
Taqiqni must ning inkor shakli bilan yozing: You ___ touch these cables. [Javob: must not / mustn't. Must not yoki mustn't harakat taqiqlanganini bildiradi.]
Majburiyat haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Do I must sign every page? B) Must I sign every page? [Javob: B. Must yordamchi modal bo‘lib, savolda egadan oldin keladi; do kerak emas.]
Have to ni moslang: The caretaker ___ unlock the gate at six. [Javob: has to. Uchinchi shaxs birlikdagi ega bilan has to ishlatiladi.]
Have to ning inkorini yozing: Entry is free. You ___ pay. [Javob: do not have to / don't have to. To‘lash zarur emasligi don't have to orqali bildiriladi.]
Savolning birinchi so‘zini yozing: ___ the driver have to show a licence? [Javob: Does. Birlikdagi the driver bilan savol Does orqali tuziladi.]
Have to ni o‘tgan zamonga qo‘ying: Last night we ___ use candles. [Javob: had to. O‘tgan majburiyat barcha egalar bilan had to orqali ifodalanadi.]
Have to ni Past Simple inkorga qo‘ying: The lift worked, so we ___ climb the stairs. [Javob: did not have to / didn't have to. O‘tgan zamonda zarurat yo‘qligi didn't have to bilan aytiladi.]
Will have to bilan to‘ldiring: When the pass expires, I ___ renew it. [Javob: will have to / 'll have to. Kelajakda paydo bo‘ladigan zarurat will have to bilan ifodalanadi.]
A yoki B: Dubulg‘a kiyish shart, uni yechish mumkin emas. A) You mustn't remove it. B) You don't have to remove it. [Javob: A. Taqiq uchun mustn't ishlatiladi.]
Should yordamida maslahatni to‘ldiring: Your bag is heavy. You ___ (use) a trolley. [Javob: should use. Maslahat uchun should + asosiy fe’l; use shakli o‘zgarmaydi.]
Should ning inkorini yozing: This shelf is weak. You ___ put heavy boxes on it. [Javob: should not / shouldn't. Shouldn't qilmaslik haqidagi maslahatni bildiradi.]
Maslahat so‘rovchi savolni tanlang: A) Which entrance should we use? B) Which entrance we should use? [Javob: A. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri savolda should egadan oldin keladi.]
Faqat predlogni yozing: You ought ___ check the address first. [Javob: to. Ought to dan keyin asosiy fe’l keladi.]
Need to ni moslang: This plant ___ more sunlight. Bo‘shliqqa need to get birikmasini moslab yozing. [Javob: needs to get. Birlikdagi this plant bilan needs to get ishlatiladi.]

A yoki B: Men chipta sotib oldim, keyin kirish bepul ekanini bildim. A) I needn't have bought a ticket. B) I didn't need to buy a ticket, so I didn't. [Javob: A. Needn't have bought bajarilgan, ammo keraksiz bo‘lgan harakatni bildiradi.]
Hozirgi ehtimol uchun may/might/could dan mosini yozing: I am not sure, but the keys ___ be in the garage. [Javob: may / might / could. Uchala modal ham bu gapda hozirgi ehtimolni bildiradi.]
May bilan ehtimoliy inkorni yozing: Perhaps Sara does not recognise us. Sara ___ recognise us. [Javob: may not. May not ehtimol tanimasligini bildiradi, qat’iy taqiqni emas.]
Must orqali hozirgi kuchli taxminni yozing: Ali has worked three night shifts. He ___ (be) exhausted. [Javob: must be. Hozirgi holatga dalil asosidagi kuchli taxmin must + be orqali ifodalanadi.]
Can't bilan kuchli inkoriy taxmin: That ___ be our bus; its number is wrong. [Javob: cannot / can't. Can't be dalil asosida bu holat mumkin emasligini bildiradi.]

Hozirgi ehtimol haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Could that noise be the washing machine? B) Could be that noise the washing machine? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi could + ega + be; be egadan keyin keladi.]
Qavsdagi fe’lni davom etayotgan ehtimolga qo‘ying: Dad might ___ (sleep) upstairs now. [Javob: be sleeping. Modal + be + -ing ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.]
Must have bilan to‘ldiring: The grass is wet, though nobody watered it. It ___ (rain) overnight. [Javob: must have rained. O‘tgan voqeaga kuchli taxmin: must have + V3.]
Might have bilan to‘ldiring: Perhaps I sent the letter to the old address. I ___ (send) it there. [Javob: might have sent. Might have + V3 o‘tgan ehtimolni bildiradi.]

Can't have bilan to‘ldiring: The parcel arrived ten minutes ago. You ___ (collect) it yesterday. [Javob: cannot have collected / can't have collected. Can't have + V3 o‘tgan harakatning imkonsizligi haqidagi xulosadir.]
Should have bilan afsusni to‘ldiring: I got lost. I ___ (save) the map before leaving. [Javob: should have saved. Should have saved qilish yaxshi bo‘lgan, ammo qilinmagan ishni bildiradi.]

Shouldn't have bilan to‘ldiring: I told everyone her secret. I ___ (say) anything. [Javob: should not have said / shouldn't have said. Shouldn't have said bajarilgan, ammo noto‘g‘ri bo‘lgan ishga afsusdir.]
Could have bilan to‘ldiring: A neighbour offered a lift, but we walked. We ___ (accept) it. [Javob: could have accepted. Could have accepted mavjud, ammo ishlatilmagan imkoniyatni bildiradi.]
Ehtimol yuqoriligini bildiring: The weather looks excellent. The picnic is ___ go ahead. A) likely to B) unlikely to [Javob: A. Be likely to hodisa yuz berishi ehtimoli yuqoriligini bildiradi.]

To‘g‘ri joylashuvni tanlang: A) She will probably find the key. B) She will find probably the key. [Javob: A. Probably yordamchi fe’ldan keyin, asosiy fe’ldan oldin kelishi mumkin; fe’l bilan obyektni ajratmaymiz.]
Umumiy qonuniyat, Zero Conditional: If this sensor detects smoke, the alarm ___ (ring). [Javob: rings. Zero Conditionalning ikkala qismida Present Simple ishlatiladi.]
Zero Conditional inkori: If the battery ___ (not work), the clock stops. [Javob: does not work / doesn't work. Birlikdagi battery bilan doesn't work; bu umumiy holat.]
Umumiy qonuniyat savoli: What ___ (happen) if milk gets too warm? [Javob: happens. What ega vazifasida kelgan; sodda hozirgi zamonda happens kerak.]
First Conditional, will bilan: If the rain stops, we ___ (eat) outside. [Javob: will eat / 'll eat. Real kelajak sharti: if + Present Simple, natija will + fe’l.]
First Conditional, will inkori: If the lift breaks, we ___ (not use) it. [Javob: will not use / won't use. Natija qismida will not + asosiy fe’l ishlatiladi.]

Real kelajak sharti haqidagi to‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Will you help if we run out of chairs? B) You will help if we run out of chairs? [Javob: A. Odatiy yozma yes/no savolda will egadan oldin keladi.]

Real kelajak sharti haqidagi odatiy wh-savolni tanlang: A) Where you will wait if the hall is locked? B) Where will you wait if the hall is locked? [Javob: B. Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + asosiy fe’l tartibi kerak.]
Buyruq shaklini yozing: If the screen freezes, ___ (restart) the app. [Javob: restart. Shartning natijasi buyruq bo‘lsa, asosiy fe’l ishlatiladi.]
Bitta bog‘lovchi: ___ you bring your pass, you won't get in. Ma’no: agar olib kelmasangiz. [Javob: Unless. Unless bu yerda if you do not ma’nosini beradi.]
Second Conditional: If I owned a boat, I ___ (visit) the island. Would dan foydalaning. [Javob: would visit / 'd visit. Faraziy hozirgi yoki kelajak natija would + fe’l bilan tuziladi.]
Second Conditional: If I ___ (not live) nearby, I would take a bus. [Javob: did not live / didn't live. If qismida Past Simple inkori: didn't + asosiy fe’l.]

Faraziy shart haqidagi odatiy yes/no savolni tanlang: A) Would you adopt a dog if you had a garden? B) You would adopt a dog if you had a garden? [Javob: A. Second Conditionalning savolida would egadan oldin keladi.]

Faraziy shart haqida to‘g‘ri wh-savolni tanlang: A) What would you buy if you won the prize? B) What you would buy if you won the prize? [Javob: A. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri wh-savolda would + ega + asosiy fe’l ishlatiladi.]
Rasmiy faraziy maslahat qolipida be ni moslang: If I ___ (be) you, I would keep the receipt. [Javob: were. If I were you — sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam degan maslahat qolipi.]
Ertaga vaqt topishim real ehtimol. A) If I have time, I'll help. B) If I had time, I'd help. Mos variantni yozing. [Javob: A. Real kelajak ehtimoli First Conditional bilan ifodalanadi.]

Shart qismi boshda turgan to‘g‘ri gapni tanlang: A) If the shop is open, I'll buy batteries. B) If will the shop open, I'll buy batteries. [Javob: A. Oldingi if qismida Present Simple ishlatiladi va undan keyin vergul keladi.]
Third Conditional: If I ___ (save) the number, I would have called. [Javob: had saved / 'd saved. O‘tgan bajarilmagan shart: if + had + V3.]
Third Conditional: If we ___ (not miss) the exit, we would have arrived on time. [Javob: had not missed / hadn't missed. Shart inkori had not + V3 orqali tuziladi.]

O‘tgan faraz haqidagi odatiy savolni tanlang: A) Would have you attended if they had invited you? B) Would you have attended if they had invited you? [Javob: B. Savol tartibi would + ega + have + V3; have egadan keyin keladi.]
Would have bilan savol: What would you ___ (do) if the gate had been locked? [Javob: have done. Would dan keyin have + V3: have done.]
Foydalanilmagan imkon: If I had brought my camera, I ___ (take) photos. Could have ishlating. [Javob: could have taken. Could have + V3 o‘tgan sharoitdagi imkoniyatni bildiradi.]
Kecha uxlamadim, hozir charchaganman. If I had slept, I ___ (feel) better now. Would ishlating. [Javob: would feel / 'd feel. O‘tgan shartning hozirgi natijasi would + asosiy fe’l bilan keladi.]

U doim inglizcha bilmaydi, kecha yo‘riqnomani tushunmadi. If he ___ (speak) English, he would have understood it. [Javob: spoke. Hozirgi umumiy holat Past Simple, o‘tgan natija would have orqali beriladi.]

Mixed Conditional: If I hadn't broken my arm, I ___ (not sit) at home now. Would bilan, davomiy shaklda yozing. [Javob: would not be sitting / wouldn't be sitting. O‘tgan shart hozir davom etayotgan holatga ta’sir qiladi.]
Hozir velosipedim yo‘q: I wish I ___ (have) a bicycle. [Javob: had. Hozirgi haqiqatga zid istakda wish + Past Simple ishlatiladi.]
Kecha eshikni qulflashni unutdim: I wish I ___ (remember) to lock it. [Javob: had remembered / 'd remembered. O‘tgan ishga afsus wish + Past Perfect orqali bildiriladi.]
Boshqa odam odati o‘zgarishini istayman: I wish my brother ___ stop borrowing my charger. [Javob: would. Wish + would boshqa birovning odati yoki xatti-harakati o‘zgarishini istashdir.]
Hozir suzolmayman: I wish I ___ swim. Qobiliyat modalini yozing. [Javob: could. Wish + could yo‘q qobiliyat yoki imkoniyatni istash uchun ishlatiladi.]
Ertangi natija hali noma’lum: I ___ you pass the exam. Hope yoki wish? [Javob: hope. Kelajakda amalga oshishi mumkin bo‘lgan istakda hope ishlatiladi.]

Shart ma’nosidagi variant: You may borrow the tent ___ you dry it afterwards. A) as long as B) even if [Javob: A. As long as qat’iy shartni bildiradi; even if shart natijani o‘zgartirmasligini bildiradi.]

Reading · Who Gets the Rehearsal Room?: Which group needs the level entrance? [Javob: the accessible singing group / singing group / the singing group. «accessible singing group needs ... level entrance» kirish ehtiyojini ko‘rsatadi.]
Listening · Sharing the Sports Budget: What is the loose surface near? [Javob: the goal / goal. «loose surface near the goal» ta’mir joyini aytadi.]
commonMistake: More better emas — better. Enough ot oldida, sifatdan keyin: enough time, old enough. Can to swim emas — can swim. She cans emas — she can. Mustn’t va don’t have to ni almashtirmang. Should to emas — should + fe’l. Must had emas — must have. Should have done ni hozirgi maslahat bilan aralashtirmang. Odatdagi First conditional da if I will emas — if I do. If oldinda bo‘lsa, ikki qism orasiga vergul. I wish I have emas — I wish I had. Wish va hope ni ma’nosiga qarab ajrating. checkQuestions: Future Passive inkori: The sports hall ___ (not close) during the holidays. [Javob: will not be closed / won't be closed. Future Passive inkori will not be + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
To‘g‘ri Future Passive savolni tanlang: A) When will the winners be announced? B) When will be the winners announced? [Javob: A. Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + be + V3 tartibi keladi.]
Can bilan passive shakl: This bag can ___ (reuse) many times. [Javob: be reused. Modal + be + V3: can be reused.]
Taqiqni modal passive bilan tanlang: A) This exit mustn't be blocked. B) This exit doesn't have to be blocked. [Javob: A. Mustn't be + V3 taqiqni, doesn't have to esa zarurat yo‘qligini bildiradi.]

Past Continuous Passive: The gate ___ (paint) when we arrived. [Javob: was being painted. O‘tgan vaqtda davom etgan passive jarayon was being + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
Past Continuous Passive inkori: The spare room ___ (not use) when I visited. [Javob: was not being used / wasn't being used. Birlikdagi ega bilan was not being + V3 ishlatiladi.]

To‘g‘ri Past Continuous Passive savolni tanlang: A) Were the shelves being installed when you arrived? B) Did the shelves being installed when you arrived? [Javob: A. Past Continuous Passive savolida were egadan oldinga chiqadi.]
Past Perfect Passive: The tables ___ (set) before the guests arrived. [Javob: had been set / 'd been set. Boshqa o‘tgan voqeadan oldin tugallangan passive ish had been + V3 bilan aytiladi.]

Past Perfect Passive inkori: The cake ___ (not cut) when the candles were brought in. [Javob: had not been cut / hadn't been cut. O‘tgan nuqtagacha tugallanmagan passive ish had not been + V3 shaklida keladi.]

To‘g‘ri Past Perfect Passive savolni tanlang: A) Had the files been copied before the computer failed? B) Had been the files copied before the computer failed? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi had + ega + been + V3.]
Bajaruvchini kiriting: The mural was painted ___ local volunteers. By yoki with ni tanlang. [Javob: by. Ishni bajargan shaxs yoki guruh passive gapda by bilan ko‘rsatiladi.]
Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: The guide ___ us that the cave was closed. (said / told) [Javob: told. Tell fe’lidan keyin kimga aytilgani bevosita keladi: told us. Say bilan esa said to us bo‘lardi.]

board: 20.1 · Active vs passive — ega va fokus: People use this room. / This room is used.
20.2 · Present Simple Passive — positive: English is spoken here.
20.3 · Present Simple Passive — negative: The office isn’t cleaned on Sundays.
20.4 · Present Simple Passive — questions: Is it made here? Where is it made?
20.5 · Past Simple Passive — positive: The bridge was built in 1990.
20.6 · Past Simple Passive — negative: The letter wasn’t sent.
20.7 · Past Simple Passive — questions: Was it repaired? When was it repaired?
20.8 · Present Continuous Passive — positive: The road is being repaired.
20.9 · Present Continuous Passive — negative: The room isn’t being used.
20.10 · Present Continuous Passive — questions: Is the house being painted?
20.11 · Present Perfect Passive — positive: The work has been finished.
20.12 · Present Perfect Passive — negative: The results haven’t been announced.
20.13 · Present Perfect Passive — questions: Has the parcel been delivered?
21.1 · Future Passive — positive: The results will be published tomorrow.
21.2 · Future Passive — negative: The results won’t be published today.
21.3 · Future Passive — questions: When will the results be published?
21.4 · Modal Passive — positive: This machine can be repaired.
21.5 · Modal Passive — negative: This door mustn’t be opened.
21.6 · Modal Passive — questions: Can this machine be repaired?
21.7 · Past Continuous Passive — positive: The car was being repaired when I called.
21.8 · Past Continuous Passive — negative: The room wasn’t being used.
21.9 · Past Continuous Passive — questions: Was the road being repaired?
21.10 · Past Perfect Passive — positive: The work had been completed before I arrived.
21.11 · Past Perfect Passive — negative: The parcel hadn’t been sent.
21.12 · Past Perfect Passive — questions: Had the tickets been booked?
21.13 · By + agent — bajaruvchini aytish: The book was written by a local author.
22.1 · Say vs tell — asosiy farq: She said she was busy. / She told me she was busy.
22.2 · Reported statements — positive: “I am tired.” → She said she was tired.
22.3 · Reported statements — negative: “I don’t know.” → He said he didn’t know.
22.4 · Backshift — present → past: “I work here.” → She said she worked there.
22.5 · Backshift — past / perfect → past perfect: “I lost it.” → He said he had lost it.
22.6 · Backshift — will → would; can → could: “I will help.” → She said she would help.
22.7 · No backshift — hali dolzarb ma’lumot: She says she lives nearby.
22.8 · Pronoun changes — kim haqida?: “My bag…” → He said his bag was missing.
22.9 · Time / place changes — kontekstga qarab: today → that day; here → there
22.10 · Reported yes/no questions — if / whether: She asked if I was ready.
22.11 · Reported wh-questions — oddiy gap tartibi: He asked where I lived.
22.12 · Reported commands — to + verb: She told me to wait.
22.13 · Reported negative commands — not to: He told us not to leave.
22.14 · Reported requests — ask + object + to: She asked me to help her.
22.15 · Reporting verbs — promise / offer / refuse: He offered to help. She refused to leave.
22.16 · Reporting verbs — suggest / admit / deny: She suggested taking a break.
23.1 · Defining relative — who: The woman who teaches us is kind.
23.2 · Defining relative — which / that: The book that I bought is useful.
23.3 · Defining relative — whose: The girl whose bag is red is my sister.
23.4 · Defining relative — where: This is the school where I studied.
23.5 · Defining relative — when: I remember the day when we met.
23.6 · Subject relative pronouns — tushirib bo‘lmaydi: The man who called is here.
23.7 · Object relative pronouns — tushirish mumkin: The book I bought is useful.
23.8 · Non-defining relative — who / which: Ali, who lives nearby, is a teacher.
23.9 · Non-defining relative — whose / where: Bukhara, where my aunt lives, is beautiful.
23.10 · Defining vs non-defining — ma’no va vergul: My brother who lives abroad… / My brother, who…
23.11 · Preposition + relative — oddiy va rasmiy: the person I spoke to / to whom I spoke
23.12 · Which referring to a whole clause: He helped us, which was kind.
23.13 · Reduced relative — -ing: The students waiting outside are in my class.
23.14 · Reduced relative — V3: The books written by her are popular.
24.1 · Verb + -ing: I enjoy reading. She avoids driving at night.
24.2 · Verb + to-infinitive: I decided to study. They hope to win.
24.3 · Verb + object + to-infinitive: I want you to listen.
24.4 · Verb + object + bare infinitive: Let me help. The joke made us laugh.
24.5 · Modal + bare infinitive: She can swim. (can to swim emas.)
24.6 · Preposition + -ing: I’m interested in learning languages.
24.7 · Infinitive of purpose: I went out to buy bread.
24.8 · Gerund as subject: Reading helps me relax.
24.9 · Adjective + to-infinitive: It is easy to understand.
24.10 · Too / enough + to-infinitive: too tired to work; old enough to drive
24.11 · Stop doing vs stop to do: He stopped smoking. / He stopped to rest.
24.12 · Remember / forget doing vs to do: Remember to call. / I remember calling.
24.13 · Try doing vs try to do: Try restarting it. / I tried to open it.
24.14 · Used to vs be used to: I used to walk. / I’m used to walking.
24.15 · Get used to + noun / -ing: I’m getting used to waking up early.
24.16 · Phrasal verbs — separable / inseparable: Turn it off. / Look after her.
24.17 · Dependent prepositions after verbs/adjectives: depend on; listen to; interested in; good at
24.18 · Have / get something done — xizmat: I had my hair cut. I’ll get my phone repaired.
