explain: Avval shu mavzulardan 5 qisqa topshiriqni yordamsiz bajartiring; xatolar bo‘yicha 3–5 mavzuni tanlang. Quyidagi doska bankidan faqat tanlangan kartalarni oching. Bir xil xato qilgan juftlarni birlashtiring, so‘ng yangi parallel misol bilan qayta tekshiring. 20.1: Passive gapda harakat ta’siridagi bench ega bo‘ladi; bajaruvchi by bilan qo‘shilishi mumkin. 20.2: Bread sanalmaydigan birlik ot; is + V3 odatiy passive harakatni bildiradi. 20.3: Birlikdagi corridor bilan is not + V3 keladi. 20.4: Present Simple Passive savolida am/is/are egadan oldinga chiqadi; do ishlatilmaydi. 20.5: O‘tgan tugallangan voqea uchun birlikdagi ega bilan was + V3 kerak. 20.6: Birlikdagi ega uchun was not + V3; send ning uchinchi shakli sent. 20.7: Past Simple Passive savolida was/were egadan oldin keladi, did emas. 20.8: Hozir davom etayotgan passive harakat is being + V3 bilan tuziladi. 20.9: Birlikdagi ega bilan is not being + V3 kerak. 20.10: So‘roq tartibi is + ega + being + V3. 20.11: Birlikdagi ega uchun has been + V3 tugallangan ishning hozirgi natijasini bildiradi. 20.12: Birlikdagi ega bilan has not been + V3 ishlatiladi. 20.13: Savol tartibi have + ega + been + V3. 21.1: Kelajakdagi passive harakat will be + V3 bilan tuziladi. 21.2: Future Passive inkori will not be + V3 bilan tuziladi. 21.3: Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + be + V3 tartibi keladi. 21.4: Modal + be + V3: can be reused. 21.5: Mustn't be + V3 taqiqni, doesn't have to esa zarurat yo‘qligini bildiradi. 21.6: Savol tartibi modal + ega + be + V3. 21.7: O‘tgan vaqtda davom etgan passive jarayon was being + V3 bilan tuziladi. 21.8: Birlikdagi ega bilan was not being + V3 ishlatiladi. 21.9: Past Continuous Passive savolida were egadan oldinga chiqadi. 21.10: Boshqa o‘tgan voqeadan oldin tugallangan passive ish had been + V3 bilan aytiladi. 21.11: O‘tgan nuqtagacha tugallanmagan passive ish had not been + V3 shaklida keladi. 21.12: Savol tartibi had + ega + been + V3. 21.13: Ishni bajargan shaxs yoki guruh passive gapda by bilan ko‘rsatiladi. 22.1: Tell fe’lidan keyin kimga aytilgani bevosita keladi: told us. Say bilan esa said to us bo‘lardi. 22.2: O‘tgan zamondagi said bilan am shakli was ga o‘zgaradi; Nina haqida she ishlatiladi. 22.3: Do not eat bir pog‘ona ortga surilganda did not eat bo‘ladi. Did dan keyin eat asosiy shaklda qoladi. 22.4: Davomiy zamonning backshift shakli was/were + -ing: am measuring → was measuring. 22.5: Broke ning Past Perfect shakli had broken: had + break fe’lining uchinchi shakli. 22.6: O‘zlashtirma gapda will ning backshift shakli would. Undan keyin reserve asosiy shaklda keladi. 22.7: Says hozirgi zamonda bo‘lgani uchun backshift kerak emas. She egasi bilan teach ga -es qo‘shiladi. 22.8: My so‘zi dastlab Markka tegishli. Mark haqida boshqa kishi xabar berganda his bo‘ladi. 22.9: Boshqa kuni xabar berilganda tomorrow asl gap aytilgan kundan keyingi kunni bildiradi: the next day yoki the following day. 22.10: Ha/yo‘q savoli o‘zlashtirilganda if yoki whether bilan kiritiladi. Berilgan variantlardan if to‘g‘ri. 22.11: Wh-so‘z saqlanadi, lekin keyin oddiy gap tartibi ishlatiladi: the alarm had rung. Past Simple backshift bilan Past Perfect bo‘ladi. 22.12: Buyruq told + shaxs + to-infinitive orqali yetkaziladi: told me to fasten. 22.13: Inkor buyruqda not to + asosiy fe’l qo‘llanadi: not to feed. 22.14: Iltimos asked + shaxs + to-infinitive bilan yetkaziladi: asked me to carry. 22.15: Promise dan keyin to-infinitive keladi: promised to return — qaytishga va’da berdi. 22.16: Suggest dan keyin bevosita fe’l kelsa, -ing shakli ishlatiladi: suggested using. 23.1: Nurse odamni bildiradi, shuning uchun berilgan variantlardan who mos keladi. 23.2: Battery narsa bo‘lgani uchun which qo‘llanadi. Bu aniqlovchi gapda that ham mumkin, ammo variantlarda which berilgan. 23.3: Murabbiy sportchiga tegishli ekanini whose coach birikmasi ko‘rsatadi. 23.4: Ergash gap kafeda sodir bo‘ladigan harakatni bildiradi; where bu yerda at which ma’nosida. 23.5: Winter vaqtni bildiradi; shu davrda sodir bo‘lgan hodisa when bilan bog‘lanadi. 23.6: That guards fe’lining egasi bo‘lib kelgan. Ega vazifasidagi nisbiy olmoshni tushirib bo‘lmaydi. 23.7: That recommended fe’lining to‘ldiruvchisi; ega you bo‘lgani uchun that ni tushirish mumkin. 23.8: Vergul bilan ajratilgan qo‘shimcha ma’lumot gapida odam uchun who ishlatiladi; that ishlatilmaydi. 23.9: Daughter oldidan egalikni bildiruvchi whose ishlatiladi. Bu qo‘shimcha ma’lumotli gaplarda ham mumkin. 23.10: Qaysi amma ekanini aniqlash uchun who is a doctor zarur. Defining relative gap vergulsiz yoziladi. 23.11: Oldinga chiqarilgan predlogdan keyin odam uchun whom ishlatiladi: with whom. With that bu nisbiy tuzilmada mumkin emas. 23.12: Which bu yerda bitta otga emas, jamoaning ikki kun oldin tugatganiga ishora qiladi. 23.13: Faol davomiy harakatni ifodalovchi who is testing qisqartirilganda testing qoladi. 23.14: Passiv aniqlovchi qisqartirilganda V3 qoladi: collected. Namunalar harakatni bajarmaydi, ular yig‘ilgan. 24.1: Mind fe’lidan keyin gerund, ya’ni -ing shakli keladi: mind closing. 24.2: Agree fe’lidan keyin to-infinitive keladi: agreed to rebuild. 24.3: Advise + shaxs + to-infinitive qolipi qo‘llanadi: advised us to keep. 24.4: Faol gapdagi make + to‘ldiruvchi dan keyin to siz asosiy fe’l keladi: made the ferry change. 24.5: Modal must dan keyin, inkor gapda ham, fe’lning to siz asosiy shakli keladi. 24.6: Without predlogidan keyin fe’l gerund shaklida keladi: without saying. 24.7: Furgon yollashning maqsadi mebellarni ko‘chirish. Maqsad to move infinitivi bilan beriladi. 24.8: Harakat gap egasi bo‘lganda gerund ishlatilishi mumkin: cycling. Cycle oxiridagi e tushadi. 24.9: Relieved sifatidan keyin hisning sababini to-infinitive bilan berish mumkin: relieved to hear. 24.10: Too + sifat + to-infinitive ortiqcha daraja harakatga to‘sqinlik qilishini bildiradi. Enough esa yetarlilikni anglatadi. 24.11: Stop + -ing o‘sha harakatni to‘xtatishni bildiradi: tirnoq tishlashni bas qildi. 24.12: Remember to do hali bajarilishi kerak bo‘lgan ishni esdan chiqarmaslikni bildiradi. 24.13: Try doing bir usulni sinab, natijasini ko‘rishni bildiradi; bu yerda asal qo‘shish tajriba sifatida taklif qilinmoqda. 24.14: Used to + asosiy fe’l o‘tmishdagi odatni bildiradi. Undan keyin collecting emas, collect keladi. 24.15: Get used to ko‘nikish jarayonini bildiradi; to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi. 24.16: Turn down ajraladigan phrasal verb. To‘ldiruvchi olmosh bo‘lsa, it fe’l va yuklama orasida turadi. 24.17: Responsible sifati for predlogi bilan keladi: responsible for doing something. 24.18: Have + narsa + V3 xizmatni boshqaga bajartirishni bildiradi: had the tiles replaced. O‘qish — «The Recipe Archive»: avval mazmunni ayttiring, so‘ng har javob yonida matndagi dalilni belgilang. Tinglash — «The Subtitle Review»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. Oldindan: contributor — material bergan kishi; kernel — mag‘iz; subtitle — subtitr. Haftalik takrorda kim aytgan/kim tahrirlagan savolini bering. Suhbatni ikki marta o‘qib asl ma’no va kuchaytirilgan talqinni belgilang. Qiynaluvchiga to‘rt grammatik tayanch bering; kuchli o‘quvchi qisqa, lekin ma’noga sodiq yangi subtitr taklif qilsin. Bu ichki kurs amaliyoti; rasmiy test yoki standart ball emas. Gapirish vazifasi: Xotira yoki intervyuni qisqartirishda izchillik uchun ayrim farqlarni olib tashlash to‘g‘rimi? 2 daqiqa davomida argument, dalil, qarshi argument va unga javob bering. Yozish vazifasi: Madaniyat forumiga retsept arxivi haqida post yozing. Turli variantlarni saqlash, o‘qish qulayligi e’tirozi va muvozanatli nashr usulini taklif qiling. 180–200 so‘z yozing. Tayyor yozuv namunasini dastlabki urinishdan keyin ko‘rsating; nusxa ko‘chirishni mustaqil natija deb baholamang.
checkQuestions: Qaysi gapda e’tibor ishni bajarganlarga emas, ishlov berilgan buyumga qaratilgan? A) Volunteers painted the bench. B) The bench was painted by volunteers. [Javob: B. Passive gapda harakat ta’siridagi bench ega bo‘ladi; bajaruvchi by bilan qo‘shilishi mumkin.]
Present Simple Passive bilan to‘ldiring: Fresh bread ___ (deliver) here every morning. [Javob: is delivered. Bread sanalmaydigan birlik ot; is + V3 odatiy passive harakatni bildiradi.]
Present Simple Passive inkori: This corridor ___ (not clean) on Saturdays. [Javob: is not cleaned / isn't cleaned. Birlikdagi corridor bilan is not + V3 keladi.]

Odatiy jarayon haqida to‘g‘ri passive savolni tanlang: A) Are these uniforms washed here? B) Do these uniforms washed here? [Javob: A. Present Simple Passive savolida am/is/are egadan oldinga chiqadi; do ishlatilmaydi.]
Past Simple Passive: The community garden ___ (open) last April. [Javob: was opened. O‘tgan tugallangan voqea uchun birlikdagi ega bilan was + V3 kerak.]
Past Simple Passive inkori: The invitation ___ (not send) yesterday. [Javob: was not sent / wasn't sent. Birlikdagi ega uchun was not + V3; send ning uchinchi shakli sent.]
Past Simple Passive savolini tanlang: A) Did the sign replaced yesterday? B) Was the sign replaced yesterday? [Javob: B. Past Simple Passive savolida was/were egadan oldin keladi, did emas.]
Present Continuous Passive: The roof ___ (repair) right now. [Javob: is being repaired. Hozir davom etayotgan passive harakat is being + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
Present Continuous Passive inkori: The main hall ___ (not use) this afternoon. [Javob: is not being used / isn't being used. Birlikdagi ega bilan is not being + V3 kerak.]
Ayni jarayon haqida to‘g‘ri passive savolni tanlang: A) Is the lift being inspected? B) Is being the lift inspected? [Javob: A. So‘roq tartibi is + ega + being + V3.]
Present Perfect Passive: The broken handle ___ (replace) already. [Javob: has been replaced. Birlikdagi ega uchun has been + V3 tugallangan ishning hozirgi natijasini bildiradi.]
Present Perfect Passive inkori: The new timetable ___ (not publish) yet. [Javob: has not been published / hasn't been published. Birlikdagi ega bilan has not been + V3 ishlatiladi.]
Present Perfect Passive savolini tanlang: A) Have the tickets been printed? B) Have been the tickets printed? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi have + ega + been + V3.]
Future Passive, will bilan: The meeting link ___ (send) tomorrow morning. [Javob: will be sent / 'll be sent. Kelajakdagi passive harakat will be + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
Future Passive inkori: The sports hall ___ (not close) during the holidays. [Javob: will not be closed / won't be closed. Future Passive inkori will not be + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
To‘g‘ri Future Passive savolni tanlang: A) When will the winners be announced? B) When will be the winners announced? [Javob: A. Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + be + V3 tartibi keladi.]
Can bilan passive shakl: This bag can ___ (reuse) many times. [Javob: be reused. Modal + be + V3: can be reused.]
Taqiqni modal passive bilan tanlang: A) This exit mustn't be blocked. B) This exit doesn't have to be blocked. [Javob: A. Mustn't be + V3 taqiqni, doesn't have to esa zarurat yo‘qligini bildiradi.]
To‘g‘ri modal passive savolni tanlang: A) Can be this fabric recycled? B) Can this fabric be recycled? [Javob: B. Savol tartibi modal + ega + be + V3.]
Past Continuous Passive: The gate ___ (paint) when we arrived. [Javob: was being painted. O‘tgan vaqtda davom etgan passive jarayon was being + V3 bilan tuziladi.]
Past Continuous Passive inkori: The spare room ___ (not use) when I visited. [Javob: was not being used / wasn't being used. Birlikdagi ega bilan was not being + V3 ishlatiladi.]

To‘g‘ri Past Continuous Passive savolni tanlang: A) Were the shelves being installed when you arrived? B) Did the shelves being installed when you arrived? [Javob: A. Past Continuous Passive savolida were egadan oldinga chiqadi.]
Past Perfect Passive: The tables ___ (set) before the guests arrived. [Javob: had been set / 'd been set. Boshqa o‘tgan voqeadan oldin tugallangan passive ish had been + V3 bilan aytiladi.]

Past Perfect Passive inkori: The cake ___ (not cut) when the candles were brought in. [Javob: had not been cut / hadn't been cut. O‘tgan nuqtagacha tugallanmagan passive ish had not been + V3 shaklida keladi.]

To‘g‘ri Past Perfect Passive savolni tanlang: A) Had the files been copied before the computer failed? B) Had been the files copied before the computer failed? [Javob: A. Savol tartibi had + ega + been + V3.]
Bajaruvchini kiriting: The mural was painted ___ local volunteers. By yoki with ni tanlang. [Javob: by. Ishni bajargan shaxs yoki guruh passive gapda by bilan ko‘rsatiladi.]
Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: The guide ___ us that the cave was closed. (said / told) [Javob: told. Tell fe’lidan keyin kimga aytilgani bevosita keladi: told us. Say bilan esa said to us bo‘lardi.]

Zamonni bir pog‘ona ortga surib, faqat bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: Nina said, ‘I am excited.’ → Nina said that she ___ excited. [Javob: was. O‘tgan zamondagi said bilan am shakli was ga o‘zgaradi; Nina haqida she ishlatiladi.]

Backshift qiling. Faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: Eva said, ‘I do not eat meat.’ → Eva said that she ___ meat. [Javob: did not eat. Do not eat bir pog‘ona ortga surilganda did not eat bo‘ladi. Did dan keyin eat asosiy shaklda qoladi.]

Present Continuous ni Past Continuous ga o‘tkazing; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Omar said, ‘I am measuring the wall.’ → Omar said that he ___ the wall. [Javob: was measuring. Davomiy zamonning backshift shakli was/were + -ing: am measuring → was measuring.]

Past Simple ni Past Perfect ga suring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Ben said, ‘I broke the handle.’ → Ben said that he ___ the handle. [Javob: had broken. Broke ning Past Perfect shakli had broken: had + break fe’lining uchinchi shakli.]

Modal fe’lni ortga suring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Dan said, ‘I will reserve a table.’ → Dan said that he ___ reserve a table. [Javob: would. O‘zlashtirma gapda will ning backshift shakli would. Undan keyin reserve asosiy shaklda keladi.]

Xabar hozir aytilmoqda. Zamonni ortga surmang; faqat fe’lni yozing: Farida says, ‘I teach biology.’ → Farida says that she ___ biology. [Javob: teaches. Says hozirgi zamonda bo‘lgani uchun backshift kerak emas. She egasi bilan teach ga -es qo‘shiladi.]

Faqat egalik olmoshini yozing: Mark said, ‘My passport has expired.’ → Mark said that ___ passport had expired. [Javob: his. My so‘zi dastlab Markka tegishli. Mark haqida boshqa kishi xabar berganda his bo‘ladi.]

Dushanba kuni Leo ‘I will return tomorrow,’ dedi. Buni payshanba kuni yetkazyapsiz. Tomorrow o‘rniga the bilan boshlanuvchi iborani yozing: Leo said he would return ___. [Javob: the next day / the following day. Boshqa kuni xabar berilganda tomorrow asl gap aytilgan kundan keyingi kunni bildiradi: the next day yoki the following day.]

Faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: ‘Have you paid the fee?’ → The clerk asked me ___ I had paid the fee. (if / that) [Javob: if. Ha/yo‘q savoli o‘zlashtirilganda if yoki whether bilan kiritiladi. Berilgan variantlardan if to‘g‘ri.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Why did the alarm ring?’ → A) He asked why the alarm had rung. B) He asked why had the alarm rung. [Javob: A. Wh-so‘z saqlanadi, lekin keyin oddiy gap tartibi ishlatiladi: the alarm had rung. Past Simple backshift bilan Past Perfect bo‘ladi.]

Buyruqni to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: ‘Fasten your seat belt,’ the pilot told me. → The pilot told me ___ my seat belt. [Javob: to fasten. Buyruq told + shaxs + to-infinitive orqali yetkaziladi: told me to fasten.]

Inkor buyruqni yetkazing; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: ‘Do not feed the deer,’ the ranger told us. → The ranger told us ___ the deer. [Javob: not to feed. Inkor buyruqda not to + asosiy fe’l qo‘llanadi: not to feed.]

Iltimosni ask bilan yetkazing; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: ‘Please carry this tray,’ the waiter said to me. → The waiter asked me ___ that tray. [Javob: to carry. Iltimos asked + shaxs + to-infinitive bilan yetkaziladi: asked me to carry.]

Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: The courier promised ___ before sunset. (return) [Javob: to return. Promise dan keyin to-infinitive keladi: promised to return — qaytishga va’da berdi.]
Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: The designer suggested ___ a larger font. (use) [Javob: using. Suggest dan keyin bevosita fe’l kelsa, -ing shakli ishlatiladi: suggested using.]

Odamni aniqlovchi olmoshni tanlang; faqat javobni yozing: The nurse ___ treated my ankle was very gentle. (who / which) [Javob: who. Nurse odamni bildiradi, shuning uchun berilgan variantlardan who mos keladi.]

Faqat mos olmoshni yozing: The battery ___ powers this sensor is tiny. (which / who) [Javob: which. Battery narsa bo‘lgani uchun which qo‘llanadi. Bu aniqlovchi gapda that ham mumkin, ammo variantlarda which berilgan.]
Egalikni bildiruvchi bitta nisbiy olmoshni yozing: The athlete ___ coach retired is looking for a new trainer. [Javob: whose. Murabbiy sportchiga tegishli ekanini whose coach birikmasi ko‘rsatadi.]

Joyni ifodalovchi where yoki which ni tanlang: We found a café ___ cyclists can refill their bottles. Faqat so‘zni yozing. [Javob: where. Ergash gap kafeda sodir bo‘ladigan harakatni bildiradi; where bu yerda at which ma’nosida.]
Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Do you recall the winter ___ the lake froze completely? (when / where) [Javob: when. Winter vaqtni bildiradi; shu davrda sodir bo‘lgan hodisa when bilan bog‘lanadi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi gapda zarur ega olmoshi bor? A) The dog that guards the warehouse belongs to Aziz. B) The dog guards the warehouse belongs to Aziz. [Javob: A. That guards fe’lining egasi bo‘lib kelgan. Ega vazifasidagi nisbiy olmoshni tushirib bo‘lmaydi.]

Faqat to‘ldiruvchi nisbiy olmoshini olib tashlab, gapni qayta yozing: The recipe that you recommended was delicious. [Javob: The recipe you recommended was delicious.. That recommended fe’lining to‘ldiruvchisi; ega you bo‘lgani uchun that ni tushirish mumkin.]

Faqat mos olmoshni yozing: Dr Evans, ___ trained in Canada, now runs our clinic. (who / that) [Javob: who. Vergul bilan ajratilgan qo‘shimcha ma’lumot gapida odam uchun who ishlatiladi; that ishlatilmaydi.]

Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Elena, ___ daughter is a violinist, invited us to a concert. (whose / who) [Javob: whose. Daughter oldidan egalikni bildiruvchi whose ishlatiladi. Bu qo‘shimcha ma’lumotli gaplarda ham mumkin.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Bir nechta ammam bor; faqat shifokor bo‘lganini ajratmoqchiman. A) My aunt who is a doctor works nights. B) My aunt, who is a doctor, works nights. [Javob: A. Qaysi amma ekanini aniqlash uchun who is a doctor zarur. Defining relative gap vergulsiz yoziladi.]

Rasmiy uslubdagi mos olmoshni yozing: The consultant with ___ we negotiated was patient. (whom / that) [Javob: whom. Oldinga chiqarilgan predlogdan keyin odam uchun whom ishlatiladi: with whom. With that bu nisbiy tuzilmada mumkin emas.]

Butun oldingi fikrga ishora qiluvchi olmoshni tanlang: The team finished two days early, ___ surprised the client. (which / what) [Javob: which. Which bu yerda bitta otga emas, jamoaning ikki kun oldin tugatganiga ishora qiladi.]

Who is qismini tushirib, fe’lni -ing shaklida saqlang. Butun gapni yozing: The technician who is testing the alarm needs silence. [Javob: The technician testing the alarm needs silence.. Faol davomiy harakatni ifodalovchi who is testing qisqartirilganda testing qoladi.]

Which were qismini olib tashlab, butun gapni yozing: The samples which were collected yesterday are frozen. [Javob: The samples collected yesterday are frozen.. Passiv aniqlovchi qisqartirilganda V3 qoladi: collected. Namunalar harakatni bajarmaydi, ular yig‘ilgan.]
Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: Do you mind ___ the window? (close) [Javob: closing. Mind fe’lidan keyin gerund, ya’ni -ing shakli keladi: mind closing.]
Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: The council agreed ___ the playground. (rebuild) [Javob: to rebuild. Agree fe’lidan keyin to-infinitive keladi: agreed to rebuild.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: The vet advised us ___ the cat indoors. (keep) [Javob: to keep. Advise + shaxs + to-infinitive qolipi qo‘llanadi: advised us to keep.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: The storm made the ferry ___ course. (change) [Javob: change. Faol gapdagi make + to‘ldiruvchi dan keyin to siz asosiy fe’l keladi: made the ferry change.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: You must not ___ this switch with wet hands. (touch) [Javob: touch. Modal must dan keyin, inkor gapda ham, fe’lning to siz asosiy shakli keladi.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: They left without ___ goodbye. (say) [Javob: saying. Without predlogidan keyin fe’l gerund shaklida keladi: without saying.]

Maqsadni to + fe’l bilan ifodalang; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: We hired a van ___ the furniture. (move) [Javob: to move. Furgon yollashning maqsadi mebellarni ko‘chirish. Maqsad to move infinitivi bilan beriladi.]
Gap egasini gerund shaklida yozing: ___ regularly improves your stamina. (cycle) [Javob: Cycling. Harakat gap egasi bo‘lganda gerund ishlatilishi mumkin: cycling. Cycle oxiridagi e tushadi.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: We were relieved ___ the good news. (hear) [Javob: to hear. Relieved sifatidan keyin hisning sababini to-infinitive bilan berish mumkin: relieved to hear.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Quti juda og‘ir, uni ko‘tara olmayman’ ma’nosini tanlang: A) The box is too heavy for me to lift. B) The box is heavy enough for me to lift. [Javob: A. Too + sifat + to-infinitive ortiqcha daraja harakatga to‘sqinlik qilishini bildiradi. Enough esa yetarlilikni anglatadi.]
U endi tirnog‘ini tishlamaydi. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: He stopped ___ his nails. (biting / to bite) [Javob: biting. Stop + -ing o‘sha harakatni to‘xtatishni bildiradi: tirnoq tishlashni bas qildi.]

Bajarilishi kerak bo‘lgan ishni eslatyapsiz. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: Remember ___ the plants before you leave. (watering / to water) [Javob: to water. Remember to do hali bajarilishi kerak bo‘lgan ishni esdan chiqarmaslikni bildiradi.]

Yechim sifatida usulni sinab ko‘rishni tavsiya qiling: If the sauce is too sour, try ___ a little honey. (adding / to add) Faqat shaklni yozing. [Javob: adding. Try doing bir usulni sinab, natijasini ko‘rishni bildiradi; bu yerda asal qo‘shish tajriba sifatida taklif qilinmoqda.]

Avvalgi, hozir yo‘q odatni ifodalang; faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: I used to ___ stamps, but I no longer do. (collect) [Javob: collect. Used to + asosiy fe’l o‘tmishdagi odatni bildiradi. Undan keyin collecting emas, collect keladi.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: It took me a month to get used to ___ on the left. (drive) [Javob: driving. Get used to ko‘nikish jarayonini bildiradi; to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Olmosh bilan to‘g‘ri gapni tanlang: A) Please turn down it. B) Please turn it down. [Javob: B. Turn down ajraladigan phrasal verb. To‘ldiruvchi olmosh bo‘lsa, it fe’l va yuklama orasida turadi.]
Faqat kerakli predlogni yozing: Who is responsible ___ locking the laboratory? (for / to) [Javob: for. Responsible sifati for predlogi bilan keladi: responsible for doing something.]

Ishni mutaxassis bajargan. Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: We had the kitchen tiles ___ last week. (replace) [Javob: replaced. Have + narsa + V3 xizmatni boshqaga bajartirishni bildiradi: had the tiles replaced.]
Reading · The Recipe Archive: What replaced almonds in one recipe? [Javob: apricot kernels / kernels from apricots. «replaced almonds with apricot kernels» aniq almashtirish.]

Listening · The Subtitle Review: Why had the family moved, according to the speaker? [Javob: work was difficult to find / difficulty finding work / to find work / lack of work. «because work was difficult to find» asl sabab; majburlash qo‘shilmagan.]
commonMistake: Is clean va is cleaned ma’nosi farq qiladi. Was build emas — was built. Will been emas — will be. Passive fe’lning oxirgi qismi V3 bo‘lishi kerak. She said me emas — she told me. Where did I live tartibini reported savolda saqlamang. Non-defining da that ishlatmang. Ega bo‘lgan relative pronoun ni tushirmang. Enjoy to read emas — enjoy reading. Used to do va be used to doing boshqa tuzilmalar. Bugungi tuzatish namunasi: The windows are cleaned every Friday. Gapning grammatik egasini aynan yozing. → The windows / windows. Passive gapda windows ishni bajarmaydi, lekin grammatik ega vazifasida turadi.
differentiation: Tayanch: «The Recipe Archive» savollarini bittadan bering, ikkita javob variantidan tanlating; doskadagi «20.1 · Active vs passive — ega va fokus: People use this room. / This room is used.» modelini ko‘rinadigan qoldiring. Gapni boshlash va dalil joyini topish uchun juftlik yordami bering. Kengaytirish: «The Subtitle Review»dagi javobni matndan dalil bilan izohlatsin; «Have / get something done — xizmat» bo‘yicha ikkinchi vaziyat yaratsin va ma’no yoki shakl tanlovini asoslasin.

objective: 187-dars — Sabab, qarama-qarshilik va natija bog‘lovchilari bilan raqam ortidagi farqlarni tushuntirish. Grammatik fokus: And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash; Because / since / as — sabab; Because of / due to + noun phrase; So / therefore / as a result — natija; Although / even though + clause; Despite / in spite of + noun / -ing; However / nevertheless — qarshi fikr; While / whereas — taqqoslab qarshi qo‘yish; So…that — sifat/ravish bilan natija Diagnostikadan tanlangan 3–5 mavzudan kamida 4/5 to‘g‘ri javob va bitta tuzatilgan ish namunasi. Gapirish va yozishda tekshiring: Because/because of va although/despite ni to‘g‘ri tuzadi; whereas yoki therefore orqali mantiqiy bog‘lanish yaratadi. Janrga mos uslubni saqlaydi va maqsadli grammatikadan kamida ikki o‘rinli misol ishlatadi.
board: 25.1 · And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash: I called, but nobody answered.
25.2 · Because / since / as — sabab: We stayed in because it was raining.
25.3 · Because of / due to + noun phrase: The match stopped because of the rain.
25.4 · So / therefore / as a result — natija: It was late, so we left.
25.5 · Although / even though + clause: Although it was cold, we went out.
25.6 · Despite / in spite of + noun / -ing: Despite the rain, we went out.
25.7 · However / nevertheless — qarshi fikr: It was cold. However, we went out.
25.8 · While / whereas — taqqoslab qarshi qo‘yish: I prefer tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
25.9 · So…that — sifat/ravish bilan natija: It was so cold that we stayed inside.
Vaziyat: A Cooler Square, a Quieter Business ↔ Why the Podcast Became Shorter
explain: Avval shu mavzulardan 5 qisqa topshiriqni yordamsiz bajartiring; xatolar bo‘yicha 3–5 mavzuni tanlang. Quyidagi doska bankidan faqat tanlangan kartalarni oching. Bir xil xato qilgan juftlarni birlashtiring, so‘ng yangi parallel misol bilan qayta tekshiring. 25.1: Or muqobil tanlovlarni bildiradi: karta bilan yoki naqd to‘lash mumkin. 25.2: Fog covered the runway ega va fe’lli gap bo‘lgani uchun because kerak; because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi. 25.3: A power failure ot birikmasi, shu sababli uning oldidan because of ishlatiladi. 25.4: Birinchi qism sabab, ikkinchisi natija. So avtomobilning yurmaganini natija sifatida bog‘laydi. 25.5: The route was steep ega-fe’lli gap. Although undan oldin kelib, kutilmagan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi. 25.6: Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: despite having a headache. 25.7: Qimmatlikka qaramay hamma joy sotilgan. Nevertheless kutilmagan zid natijani bildiradi. 25.8: Whereas ikki turli odatni taqqoslab, qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi; sabab bildirmaydi. 25.9: Narrow sifatidan oldin so ishlatiladi: so + sifat + that + natija. O‘qish — «A Cooler Square, a Quieter Business»: avval mazmunni ayttiring, so‘ng har javob yonida matndagi dalilni belgilang. Tinglash — «Why the Podcast Became Shorter»: transkriptni yashiring; birinchi o‘qishda vaziyat, ikkinchisida uch tafsilot. Javobdan keyingina transkriptni oching. Oldindan: shade sail — matoli soyabon; footfall — piyodalar oqimi; transition — o‘tish bog‘lanishi. Matnda sabab va natijani strelka bilan ulang. Suhbatni ikki marta o‘qib although/despite ma’nosini izohlang. Qiynaluvchiga clause/noun qoliplarini bering; kuchli o‘quvchi ikki manfaatni bitta tavsiyada birlashtirsin. Bu ichki kurs amaliyoti; rasmiy test yoki standart ball emas. Gapirish vazifasi: Umumiy yaxshilanishga qaramay ayrim guruhlar zarar ko‘rsa, loyiha qayta ko‘rib chiqilishi kerakmi? 2 daqiqa davomida argument, dalil, qarshi argument va unga javob bering. Yozish vazifasi: Do‘stingiz Rayhonga soyabonli maydon haqida norasmiy email yozing. Foyda, kiosk muammosi va kichik o‘zgarish taklifini kiriting. 45–55 so‘z yozing. Tayyor yozuv namunasini dastlabki urinishdan keyin ko‘rsating; nusxa ko‘chirishni mustaqil natija deb baholamang.

Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: The flight was cancelled ___ fog covered the runway. (because / because of) [Javob: because. Fog covered the runway ega va fe’lli gap bo‘lgani uchun because kerak; because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi.]
Faqat mos iborani yozing: The museum closed early ___ a power failure. (because / because of) [Javob: because of. A power failure ot birikmasi, shu sababli uning oldidan because of ishlatiladi.]

Natijani bildiruvchi bog‘lovchini tanlang: The battery was flat, ___ the car would not start. (so / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing. [Javob: so. Birinchi qism sabab, ikkinchisi natija. So avtomobilning yurmaganini natija sifatida bog‘laydi.]

Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: ___ the route was steep, the children reached the top. (Although / Despite) [Javob: Although. The route was steep ega-fe’lli gap. Although undan oldin kelib, kutilmagan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: Despite ___ a headache, Karim finished the rehearsal. (have) [Javob: having. Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: despite having a headache.]

Qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘lang; faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tickets were expensive. ___, every seat was sold. (Nevertheless / Therefore) [Javob: Nevertheless. Qimmatlikka qaramay hamma joy sotilgan. Nevertheless kutilmagan zid natijani bildiradi.]

Ikki kishining qarama-qarshi odatini bog‘lang: I save every receipt, ___ my brother throws them away. (whereas / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing. [Javob: whereas. Whereas ikki turli odatni taqqoslab, qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi; sabab bildirmaydi.]
Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tunnel was ___ narrow that two cars could not pass. (so / such) [Javob: so. Narrow sifatidan oldin so ishlatiladi: so + sifat + that + natija.]

Kelajak haqida gap: faqat to‘g‘ri fe’l shaklini yozing: I will message you as soon as the plane ___. (lands / will land) [Javob: lands. Kelajak ma’nosidagi as soon as vaqt ergash gapida odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi, will qo‘yilmaydi.]

Oldindan ehtiyot chorasi nazarda tutilgan. Faqat iborani yozing: Save an offline copy ___ the internet fails during the presentation. (in case / if) [Javob: in case. In case ehtimoliy muammo yuz berishidan oldin tayyorlanishni bildiradi: internet uzilib qolishi ehtimoliga qarshi nusxa saqlanadi.]

Ikkalasida ham yo‘qligini bildiring; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Neither the cabin ___ the tent has electricity. (or / nor) [Javob: nor. Neither ... nor juftligi ikki narsani ham inkor qiladi. Neither bilan nor moslashadi.]

board: 25.1 · And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash: I called, but nobody answered.
25.2 · Because / since / as — sabab: We stayed in because it was raining.
25.3 · Because of / due to + noun phrase: The match stopped because of the rain.
25.4 · So / therefore / as a result — natija: It was late, so we left.
25.5 · Although / even though + clause: Although it was cold, we went out.
25.6 · Despite / in spite of + noun / -ing: Despite the rain, we went out.
25.7 · However / nevertheless — qarshi fikr: It was cold. However, we went out.
25.8 · While / whereas — taqqoslab qarshi qo‘yish: I prefer tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
25.9 · So…that — sifat/ravish bilan natija: It was so cold that we stayed inside.
25.10 · Such…that — ot birikmasi bilan natija: It was such a good book that I read it twice.
25.11 · To / in order to / so as to — maqsad: I study to improve my English.
25.12 · So that + clause — maqsad: I spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.
25.13 · Before / after / until / as soon as: Wait until I return.
25.14 · In case vs if — ehtiyot va shart: Take a coat in case it gets cold.
25.15 · Both…and / either…or / neither…nor: You can either walk or take a bus.
25.16 · Not only…but also — parallel shakllar: She is not only kind but also patient.
25.17 · Adding and exemplifying — qo‘shimcha/misol: Moreover…; for example…; for instance…
25.18 · Paragraph links and punctuation: It was raining; however, we continued.
26.1 · Subject–verb agreement — oddiy va murakkab ega: The list of names is on the desk.
26.2 · Indefinite pronouns — birlikdagi fe’l: Everyone is ready. Nobody knows.
26.3 · Articles — general vs specific meaning: Life is difficult. / The life of this artist…
26.4 · Articles — places, institutions, geography: at school; in the school; the Nile; Uzbekistan
26.5 · Countability shifts — ma’noga qarab: some chicken / a chicken; some paper / a paper
26.6 · Adjective order — ot oldidagi sifatlar: a beautiful old wooden chair
26.7 · -ed vs -ing adjectives: I’m interested. / The topic is interesting.
26.8 · Gradable / non-gradable adjectives: very cold; absolutely freezing
26.9 · Adverb position and scope: She almost finished. / Only she finished.
26.10 · Indirect questions — yes/no: Could you tell me if the bank is open?
26.11 · Indirect questions — wh-: Do you know where she lives?
26.12 · Question tags — positive statement: You work here, don’t you?
26.13 · Question tags — negative statement: She isn’t ready, is she?
26.14 · So / neither + auxiliary — qo‘shilish: So do I. / Neither have I.
26.15 · Stative vs dynamic meanings: I think it’s good. / I’m thinking about it.
27.1 · Future Continuous — positive: I’ll be studying at eight tomorrow.
27.2 · Future Continuous — negative: I won’t be working tomorrow morning.
27.3 · Future Continuous — yes/no questions: Will you be working tomorrow?
27.4 · Future Continuous — wh-questions: What will you be doing at eight?
27.5 · Future Perfect — positive: I’ll have finished by Friday.
27.6 · Future Perfect — negative: I won’t have finished by then.
27.7 · Future Perfect — questions: Will you have finished by noon?
27.8 · Future Continuous — short answers: Yes, I will. / No, she won’t.
27.9 · Future Perfect — wh-questions: What will you have finished by Friday?
27.10 · Future Perfect — short answers: Yes, I will. / No, they won’t.
27.11 · Future Continuous vs Future Perfect: At six, I’ll be working. / By six, I’ll have finished.
27.12 · By / by the time — yakun muddati: I’ll have left by the time you arrive.
27.13 · Future in the past — was going to / would: I was going to call, but I forgot.

checkQuestions: Ikki muqobil tanlovni bog‘lang. Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: You may pay by card ___ use cash. (and / but / or) [Javob: or. Or muqobil tanlovlarni bildiradi: karta bilan yoki naqd to‘lash mumkin.]

Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: The flight was cancelled ___ fog covered the runway. (because / because of) [Javob: because. Fog covered the runway ega va fe’lli gap bo‘lgani uchun because kerak; because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi.]
Faqat mos iborani yozing: The museum closed early ___ a power failure. (because / because of) [Javob: because of. A power failure ot birikmasi, shu sababli uning oldidan because of ishlatiladi.]

Natijani bildiruvchi bog‘lovchini tanlang: The battery was flat, ___ the car would not start. (so / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing. [Javob: so. Birinchi qism sabab, ikkinchisi natija. So avtomobilning yurmaganini natija sifatida bog‘laydi.]

Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: ___ the route was steep, the children reached the top. (Although / Despite) [Javob: Although. The route was steep ega-fe’lli gap. Although undan oldin kelib, kutilmagan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.]
Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: Despite ___ a headache, Karim finished the rehearsal. (have) [Javob: having. Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: despite having a headache.]

Qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘lang; faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tickets were expensive. ___, every seat was sold. (Nevertheless / Therefore) [Javob: Nevertheless. Qimmatlikka qaramay hamma joy sotilgan. Nevertheless kutilmagan zid natijani bildiradi.]

Ikki kishining qarama-qarshi odatini bog‘lang: I save every receipt, ___ my brother throws them away. (whereas / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing. [Javob: whereas. Whereas ikki turli odatni taqqoslab, qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi; sabab bildirmaydi.]
Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tunnel was ___ narrow that two cars could not pass. (so / such) [Javob: so. Narrow sifatidan oldin so ishlatiladi: so + sifat + that + natija.]
Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: It was ___ an exciting final that nobody left early. (so / such) [Javob: such. An exciting final ot birikmasi. Such + a/an + sifat + ot + that qolipi ishlatiladi.]

Faqat yetishmayotgan so‘zni yozing: We left quietly in order ___ wake the patients. (not to / to not to) [Javob: not to. Inkor maqsad in order not to + fe’l bilan beriladi: bemorlarni uyg‘otmaslik uchun.]

Faqat mos iborani yozing: I emailed the diagram ___ the engineer could check it before the meeting. (so that / in order to) [Javob: so that. Keyingi qismning o‘z egasi va modal fe’li bor: the engineer could. Bunday maqsad gapini so that bog‘laydi.]

Kelajak haqida gap: faqat to‘g‘ri fe’l shaklini yozing: I will message you as soon as the plane ___. (lands / will land) [Javob: lands. Kelajak ma’nosidagi as soon as vaqt ergash gapida odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi, will qo‘yilmaydi.]

Oldindan ehtiyot chorasi nazarda tutilgan. Faqat iborani yozing: Save an offline copy ___ the internet fails during the presentation. (in case / if) [Javob: in case. In case ehtimoliy muammo yuz berishidan oldin tayyorlanishni bildiradi: internet uzilib qolishi ehtimoliga qarshi nusxa saqlanadi.]

Ikkalasida ham yo‘qligini bildiring; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Neither the cabin ___ the tent has electricity. (or / nor) [Javob: nor. Neither ... nor juftligi ikki narsani ham inkor qiladi. Neither bilan nor moslashadi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Parallel tuzilmani tanlang: A) The course teaches not only coding but also drawing. B) The course teaches not only coding but also to draw. [Javob: A. Not only va but also dan keyingi qismlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo‘lishi kerak: coding va drawing.]

Qo‘shimcha dalil kiriting; faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The hostel is close to the station. ___, breakfast is included. (Moreover / However) [Javob: Moreover. Ikkinchi gap yana bir afzallikni qo‘shmoqda. Moreover qo‘shimcha dalilni kiritadi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Standart yozma ingliz tilida tinish belgilarini to‘g‘ri tanlang: A) The deadline was tight; however, we submitted the report on time. B) The deadline was tight, however, we submitted the report on time. [Javob: A. However ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulay olmaydi. Uning oldidan nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul qo‘yish to‘g‘ri.]
Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: The box of spare cables ___ under the counter. (is / are) [Javob: is. Eganing bosh so‘zi birlikdagi box. Of spare cables ichidagi ko‘plik kesimni o‘zgartirmaydi.]
Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: Somebody ___ left a scarf on the bus. (has / have) [Javob: has. Somebody grammatik jihatdan birlikdagi olmosh, shuning uchun has bilan moslashadi.]

Umumiy ma’noda gapiring. Faqat the yoki artikl kerak bo‘lmasa zero deb yozing: ___ patience is essential when training animals. [Javob: zero. Patience umumiy ma’nodagi sanalmaydigan ot. Bu yerda artikl ishlatilmaydi.]
Faqat the yoki artikl kerak bo‘lmasa zero deb yozing: They sailed along ___ Danube last summer. [Javob: the. Daryo nomlari odatda the bilan ishlatiladi: the Danube.]

Material ma’nosi nazarda tutilgan. Faqat mos variantni yozing: This sculpture is made of ___. (glass / a glass) [Javob: glass. Glass material sifatida sanalmaydigan ot. A glass esa bitta ichimlik stakanini bildiradi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Neytral uslubdagi tabiiy sifat tartibini tanlang: A) a small round mirror B) a round small mirror [Javob: A. Odatdagi sifat tartibida hajm shakldan oldin keladi: small — hajm, round — shakl.]

Faqat mos sifatni yozing: The instructions were so ___ that nobody could assemble the shelf. (confused / confusing) [Javob: confusing. Yo‘riqnoma chalkashlikni keltirib chiqaradi, shu sababli confusing. Confused esa chalkashgan kishining holatini bildiradi.]

Oddiy darajalanuvchi sifat bilan standart birikmani tanlang; faqat variantni yozing: The room was ___. (very warm / absolutely warm) [Javob: very warm. Warm darajalanuvchi sifat; very uning darajasini kuchaytiradi. Absolutely odatda mutlaq yoki kuchli chegaraviy sifatlar bilan keladi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Faqat Maya taklifni rad etdi; boshqalar qabul qildi’ ma’nosi qaysi? A) Only Maya rejected the offer. B) Maya only rejected the offer. [Javob: A. Only ega Maya oldida tursa, boshqa odamlarni istisno qiladi. Fe’l oldida tursa, odatda harakatning o‘zini cheklaydi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri bilvosita savolni tanlang: A) Could you tell me if does this bus stop at the stadium? B) Could you tell me if this bus stops at the stadium? [Javob: B. If dan keyin oddiy gap tartibi kerak: this bus stops. Does bilan savol inversiyasi ishlatilmaydi.]

Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. A) Can you explain why the machine keeps stopping? B) Can you explain why does the machine keep stopping? [Javob: A. Bilvosita wh-savolda why dan keyin ega va kesim oddiy tartibda keladi; does bilan inversiya qilinmaydi.]

Faqat qisqa tasdiqlovchi savol qismini yozing; inkor yordamchini qisqartiring: The printer works now, ___? [Javob: doesn't it / doesn’t it. Tasdiq Present Simple gapiga inkor tag qo‘shiladi. Printer uchun it, works uchun does yordamchisi kerak: doesn’t it.]
Faqat tag qismini yozing: The driver did not see the sign, ___? Haydovchi erkak. [Javob: did he. Inkor Past Simple gapidan keyin tasdiq yordamchi did keladi. Erkak haydovchi uchun he ishlatiladi.]
‘Men ham’ deb qo‘shiling. Javobni So bilan boshlang: ‘I can juggle.’ — ‘___.’ [Javob: So can I. Tasdiq gapga qo‘shilishda so + yordamchi/modal + ega keladi. Can modal fe’li takrorlanadi.]

Bilish ma’nosidagi holatni ifodalang. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: I ___ exactly what you mean. (understand / am understanding) [Javob: understand. Understand bu ma’noda holat fe’li. Oddiy hozirgi zamondagi understand tabiiy shakl hisoblanadi.]

Future Continuous bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: At this time on Saturday, we ___ over the Alps. (fly) [Javob: will be flying. Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etadigan harakat will be + -ing bilan ifodalanadi: will be flying.]

Future Continuous inkor shaklini yozing; faqat bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring, qisqartma ishlatmang: I ___ the car at lunchtime tomorrow, so you can borrow it. (not / use) [Javob: will not be using. Inkor Future Continuous will not be + -ing bilan tuziladi: will not be using.]

Gapni Future Continuous ha/yo‘q savoliga aylantiring. Butun savolni yozing: The children will be camping this weekend. [Javob: Will the children be camping this weekend?. Savolda will egadan oldinga chiqadi. Be camping egadan keyin qoladi.]

Qavsdagi fe’lni Future Continuous savolida qo‘llang. Bo‘shliqlardagi so‘zlarni tartib bilan bitta javob qilib yozing: Where ___ you ___ during the renovation? (sleep) [Javob: will be sleeping. To‘liq savol Where will you be sleeping during the renovation? bo‘ladi. Birinchi bo‘shliq will, ikkinchisi be sleeping.]

Future Perfect bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: By September, Aisha ___ her driving course. (complete) [Javob: will have completed. Kelajakdagi muddatgacha tugaydigan ish will have + V3 bilan beriladi: will have completed.]

Future Perfect inkor shaklini yozing; qisqartma ishlatmang, faqat bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: By Monday, the paint ___ completely. (not / dry) [Javob: will not have dried. Future Perfect inkori will not have + V3. Dry fe’lining V3 shakli dried.]

Gapni Future Perfect ha/yo‘q savoliga aylantiring. Butun savolni yozing: The snow will have melted by April. [Javob: Will the snow have melted by April?. Future Perfect savolida will egadan oldin, have + V3 esa undan keyin keladi.]

Tasdiq qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will you be leading the tour tomorrow?’ — ‘___.’ O‘zingiz haqingizda I bilan javob bering. [Javob: Yes, I will.. Future Continuous qisqa javobida faqat will yordamchisi takrorlanadi: Yes, I will. Be leading takrorlanmaydi.]

How many bilan boshlang. Faqat A yoki B ni yozing: A) How many chapters will you have edited by Tuesday? B) How many chapters you will have edited by Tuesday? [Javob: A. Bevosita wh-savolda will egadan oldin turadi. Have edited kelajakdagi muddatgacha tugallangan ishni so‘raydi.]

Tasdiq qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will Jamila have submitted her thesis by June?’ — ‘___.’ She ishlating. [Javob: Yes, she will.. Future Perfect savoliga qisqa javob will bilan beriladi: Yes, she will. Have submitted qaytarilmaydi.]

Soat uchda safar hali davom etadi. Faqat mos iborani yozing: At three, we ___. (will be travelling / will have arrived) [Javob: will be travelling. O‘sha vaqtdagi davom etayotgan jarayon Future Continuous bilan beriladi. Will have arrived esa yetib kelish tugaganini bildiradi.]

‘Payshanbagacha tayyorlab bo‘lamiz’ ma’nosini bering. Faqat predlogni yozing: We will have prepared the contract ___ Thursday. (by / until) [Javob: by. By ish tugallanishining eng kech muddatini bildiradi. Until esa odatda shu vaqtgacha davom etishni ko‘rsatadi.]

O‘tmishdagi amalga oshmagan rejani was going to bilan bering. Faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: I ___ a picnic, but the forecast changed. (organise) [Javob: was going to organise / was going to organize. Was going to + fe’l o‘tmishda rejalashtirilgan ishni bildiradi. Ob-havo prognozi o‘zgargani uchun reja amalga oshmagan.]

Reading · A Certificate That Explains Itself: How many pieces of work will each learner select? [Javob: two / 2 / two pieces / 2 pieces / two pieces of work. «selected two pieces of work» dalil hajmini beradi.]
Listening · The Final Project Conversation: How many extracts will the learner present? [Javob: two / 2 / two extracts / 2 extracts. «two edited extracts» taqdimot tarkibi.]
commonMistake: Despite of emas — despite. Although va but ni bitta bog‘lash uchun takrorlamang. Everyone are emas — everyone is. Do you know where is he emas — where he is. Will have finish emas — will have finished. By the time dan keyin odatda Present Simple. Bugungi tuzatish namunasi: Qarama-qarshi fikrni ulang; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: The suitcase looks small, ___ it holds a lot. (and / but / or) → but. Tashqi kichik hajm va katta sig‘im qarama-qarshi qo‘yilmoqda; but shu zidlikni bildiradi.
differentiation: Tayanch: «A Certificate That Explains Itself» savollarini bittadan bering, ikkita javob variantidan tanlating; doskadagi «25.1 · And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash: I called, but nobody answered.» modelini ko‘rinadigan qoldiring. Gapni boshlash va dalil joyini topish uchun juftlik yordami bering. Kengaytirish: «The Final Project Conversation»dagi javobni matndan dalil bilan izohlatsin; «Future in the past — was going to / would» bo‘yicha ikkinchi vaziyat yaratsin va ma’no yoki shakl tanlovini asoslasin.
